<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>SIFT macOS</title>
<link rel="icon" id="fav" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Crect width='100' height='100' rx='22' fill='%2307080c'/%3E%3Crect x='22' y='22' width='56' height='56' rx='14' transform='rotate(45 50 50)' fill='none' stroke='white' stroke-width='11'/%3E%3Crect x='39' y='39' width='22' height='22' rx='6' transform='rotate(45 50 50)' fill='white'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Pacifico&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free@6.5.2/css/all.min.css">
<style>
:root{
  --txt:#f4f6fb;
  --mut:rgba(235,240,250,.62);
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  --line-bright:rgba(255,255,255,.28);
  --acc:#2b7fff;
  --acc2:#a78bfa;
  --glass:rgba(18,22,34,.52);
  --glass-heavy:rgba(14,18,28,.78);
  --glass-card:rgba(255,255,255,.055);
  --glass-card-hover:rgba(255,255,255,.095);
  --bar:rgba(22,27,40,.65);
  --blur:blur(36px) saturate(190%);
  --shadow:0 28px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.48), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22);
}

body[data-theme="obsidian"]{
  --glass:rgba(8,9,13,.74);
  --glass-heavy:rgba(5,6,9,.88);
  --glass-card:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  --bar:rgba(10,11,16,.78);
}
body[data-theme="crystal"]{
  --txt:#111827;
  --mut:rgba(17,24,39,.65);
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.45);
  --line-bright:rgba(255,255,255,.75);
  --glass:rgba(245,247,252,.48);
  --glass-heavy:rgba(250,252,255,.78);
  --glass-card:rgba(255,255,255,.38);
  --glass-card-hover:rgba(255,255,255,.58);
  --bar:rgba(255,255,255,.50);
  --shadow:0 24px 64px rgba(15,23,42,.16), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.85);
}

*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#07080c;color:var(--txt);font:13px/1.45 'Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button,input,select{font:inherit;color:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--acc);outline-offset:2px}
.ic{font-size:14px;line-height:1}

.ib{height:34px;padding:0 15px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;background:var(--glass-card);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);transition:all .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);font-weight:500;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px}
.ib:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--glass-card-hover);border-color:var(--line-bright);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.ib.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--acc),var(--acc2));border:0;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(43,127,255,.35)}

.spin{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;border:2.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-top-color:var(--acc);animation:sp .8s linear infinite}@keyframes sp{to{rotate:360deg}}

/* AUTHENTIC MACOS "HELLO" STARTUP & SETUP WIZARD SCREEN */
#boot{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;
  background:#07080c;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  overflow:hidden;
  transition:opacity .85s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), transform 1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), visibility 0s 1s;
}
#boot-wall-blur{
  position:absolute;inset:-48px;
  background:#07080c center/cover no-repeat;
  filter:blur(44px) saturate(165%) brightness(.85);
  transform:scale(1.14);
  transition:filter .75s ease, transform 1s ease;
  pointer-events:none;
}
#boot-wall-blur::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, rgba(0,0,0,.04) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,.36) 100%);
}
#boot.step-setup #boot-wall-blur{filter:blur(48px) saturate(150%) brightness(.68)}
#boot.step-welcome #boot-wall-blur{filter:blur(54px) saturate(140%) brightness(.58)}
#boot.done{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.04);pointer-events:none;visibility:hidden}

.hello-stage{
  position:relative;z-index:2;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  margin-top:-30px;
}
.hello-svg{
  width:clamp(260px, 32vw, 450px);
  height:auto;
  overflow:visible;
}
.hello-stroke{
  fill:none;
  stroke:#ffffff;
  stroke-width:9;
  stroke-linecap:round;
  stroke-linejoin:round;
  stroke-dasharray:1 2;
  stroke-dashoffset:1.01;
  animation:helloDraw 3s cubic-bezier(.38,.04,.25,1) .3s forwards;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.38));
}
@keyframes helloDraw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}

.hello-start-btn{
  position:absolute;bottom:54px;z-index:3;
  background:none;border:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,.94);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.02em;
  cursor:pointer;opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px);
  animation:helloBtnIn .8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) 3.1s forwards;
  transition:color .2s, transform .2s;
  text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.75);
}
.hello-start-btn:hover{color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
@keyframes helloBtnIn{to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.hello-start-ico{
  width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-size:9.5px;
  transition:background .2s, transform .2s;
}
.hello-start-btn:hover .hello-start-ico{background:rgba(255,255,255,.24);transform:scale(1.08)}

/* Setup Wizard Steps */
.setup-step{
  position:relative;z-index:3;
  width:min(440px, 90vw);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;
  animation:pop .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
}
.setup-step h2{
  font-size:25px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:#ffffff;
  margin-bottom:8px;text-shadow:0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}
.setup-desc{
  font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);
  max-width:360px;margin-bottom:22px;
}
.setup-table{
  width:100%;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  backdrop-filter:blur(26px) saturate(155%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(26px) saturate(155%);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.24);
  box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
  transition:box-shadow .18s, border-color .18s;
}
.setup-table:focus-within{
  border-color:#2b7fff;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2.5px #2b7fff, 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
}
.setup-row{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  height:40px;padding:0 14px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);
}
.setup-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.setup-row label{
  font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#ffffff;
  white-space:nowrap;margin-right:12px;
}
.setup-row input{
  flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:none;outline:none;
  text-align:right;font-size:13px;color:#ffffff;
}
.setup-row input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.48);font-weight:400}
.setup-footnote{
  margin-top:12px;font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.68);
}
.setup-continue-row{margin-top:20px}
.setup-pill-btn{
  height:30px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  color:#fff;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;
  transition:background .16s, transform .14s;
}
.setup-pill-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.32);transform:translateY(-1px)}

/* Choose Your Look Step */
.look-options{
  display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:20px;
}
.look-choice{
  background:none;border:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;
}
.look-thumb{
  width:94px;height:62px;border-radius:10px;padding:8px;
  border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .16s, transform .16s;
}
.look-choice:hover .look-thumb{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.look-choice.selected .look-thumb{
  border-color:#2b7fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #2b7fff, 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}
.look-thumb.light{background:linear-gradient(135deg, #a78bfa 0%, #f472b6 55%, #fbbf24 100%)}
.look-thumb.dark{background:linear-gradient(135deg, #1e1b4b 0%, #311042 55%, #0f172a 100%)}
.look-thumb.auto{background:linear-gradient(105deg, #93c5fd 0%, #c084fc 49.5%, #1e1b4b 50.5%, #0f172a 100%)}
.lt-win{
  width:62px;height:36px;border-radius:5px;padding:4px 5px;
  background:#ffffff;box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;
}
.look-thumb.dark .lt-win{background:#1f2430}
.look-thumb.auto .lt-win{background:linear-gradient(105deg, #ffffff 49.5%, #1f2430 50.5%)}
.lt-dots{display:flex;gap:2.5px}
.lt-dots i{width:3.5px;height:3.5px;border-radius:50%;display:block}
.lt-dots i:nth-child(1){background:#ff5f57}
.lt-dots i:nth-child(2){background:#febc2e}
.lt-dots i:nth-child(3){background:#28c840}
.lt-dock{
  width:46px;height:5px;border-radius:3px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);
}
.accent-dots{
  display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
}
.accent-dot{
  width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:10px;
  transition:transform .14s, border-color .14s;
}
.accent-dot i{opacity:0;transition:opacity .12s}
.accent-dot.selected{border-color:#fff;transform:scale(1.12)}
.accent-dot.selected i{opacity:1}

/* Welcome & Login Screen */
.welcome-circle{
  width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg, #22c55e, #16a34a);
  color:#fff;font-size:36px;font-weight:700;
  display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0 auto 16px;
  box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(34,197,94,.4);
}
.welcome-title{
  font-size:26px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin-bottom:6px;
  text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}
.welcome-sub{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);max-width:320px}
.lock-login-box{margin-top:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.lock-pass-pill{
  width:280px;height:42px;border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 6px 0 16px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
.lock-pass-pill input{
  flex:1;border:0;background:none;outline:none;font-size:13.5px;color:#fff;
}
.lock-pass-pill input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.lock-go-btn{
  width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);color:#111;
  display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;transition:transform .15s,background .15s;
}
.lock-go-btn:hover{background:#fff;transform:scale(1.08)}
.lock-hint-txt{font-size:11.5px;color:#fca5a5}
@keyframes shake{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}20%,60%{transform:translateX(-6px)}40%,80%{transform:translateX(6px)}}
.shake{animation:shake .38s ease}

/* WALLPAPER */
#wall{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#07080c center/cover no-repeat;transition:background-image .5s ease, transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);transform:scale(1.04)}
body.booted #wall{transform:scale(1)}
#wall::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 25%,rgba(0,0,0,.08),rgba(0,0,0,.38))}

/* TOP BAR */
#top{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:26;height:30px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 14px;
  background:rgba(16,19,28,.55);
  backdrop-filter:blur(32px) saturate(190%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(32px) saturate(190%);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  font-size:12.5px;
  transform:translateY(-100%);transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) .15s;
}
body.booted #top{transform:translateY(0)}
body.in-fullscreen #top{transform:translateY(-110%)!important;opacity:0!important;visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}
.top-left,.top-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px}
#top button{
  height:22px;padding:0 9px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:none;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-weight:500;color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);
  transition:background .14s, color .14s;
}
#top button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff}
.brand-diamond{padding:0 8px!important;font-size:14px}
.brand-diamond svg{width:15px;height:15px;display:block}
.top-active-app{font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.top-menu-item{font-weight:400!important;opacity:.9}
.top-icon-btn{width:28px;height:22px;padding:0!important;justify-content:center!important;font-size:12.5px}
.cc-toggle-icon{width:15px;height:14px;display:block}
#clock{font-weight:500;padding:0 4px 0 8px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.94);letter-spacing:-.01em;white-space:nowrap}

/* EXPOSE MISSION CONTROL */
#expose{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:22;
  background:rgba(10,13,22,.48);
  backdrop-filter:blur(38px) saturate(185%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(38px) saturate(185%);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:56px 42px 96px;overflow-y:auto;
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .28s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), visibility 0s .28s;
}
#expose.open{
  opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto;
  transition:opacity .28s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), visibility 0s 0s;
}
.ex-grid{
  width:min(1260px, 95vw);
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 300px));
  justify-content:center;gap:34px 26px;
}
.ex-item{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  cursor:pointer;position:relative;
  transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.25,1.2);
}
.ex-item:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.03)}
.ex-win-box{
  width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/10.5;border-radius:12px;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(32,37,50,.92), rgba(20,23,32,.96));
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  box-shadow:0 22px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.55), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative;
  transition:border-color .18s, box-shadow .18s;
}
.ex-item:hover .ex-win-box{
  border-color:rgba(106,149,255,.85);
  box-shadow:0 26px 56px rgba(0,0,0,.65), 0 0 0 2px rgba(106,149,255,.45);
}
.ex-win-chrome{
  height:24px;padding:0 10px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
}
.ex-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%}
.ex-dot.r{background:#ff5f57}.ex-dot.y{background:#febc2e}.ex-dot.g{background:#28c840}
.ex-win-body{flex:1;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#0d111a}
.ex-preview-stage{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;transform-origin:top left;pointer-events:none}
.ex-preview-stage .win{position:static!important;animation:none!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;background:rgba(18,22,34,.92)!important}
.ex-close-btn{
  position:absolute;top:-8px;left:-8px;z-index:4;
  width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  background:rgba(28,32,42,.92);color:#fff;
  display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:11px;
  box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  opacity:0;transform:scale(.85);
  transition:opacity .16s, transform .16s, background .15s;
}
.ex-item:hover .ex-close-btn,.ex-close-btn:focus-visible{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}
.ex-close-btn:hover{background:#ef4444;border-color:#fca5a5}
.ex-label{
  font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:rgba(255,255,255,.94);
  text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.75);
  max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;
}

/* SPOTLIGHT */
#spotlight{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:35;
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;
  padding-top:16vh;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.18);
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .16s ease, visibility 0s .16s;
}
#spotlight.open{
  opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto;
  transition:opacity .16s ease, visibility 0s 0s;
}
.sp-box{
  width:min(640px, 92vw);
  border-radius:14px;
  background:rgba(36,38,48,.88);
  backdrop-filter:blur(44px) saturate(190%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(44px) saturate(190%);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  box-shadow:0 32px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.65), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  overflow:hidden;
  transform:scale(.97) translateY(-6px);
  transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
}
#spotlight.open .sp-box{transform:scale(1) translateY(0)}
.sp-input-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:56px;padding:0 18px}
.sp-input-row i{font-size:20px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.52)}
.sp-input-row input{flex:1;border:0;background:none;outline:none;font-size:23px;font-weight:400;color:#fff;caret-color:#fff}
.sp-input-row input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.sp-results{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);padding:6px;max-height:340px;overflow-y:auto}
.sp-results:empty{display:none}
.sp-row{
  width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  padding:7px 12px;border:0;border-radius:9px;
  background:none;text-align:left;color:#fff;
  transition:background .08s;
}
.sp-row.active{background:#ff5c93;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(255,92,147,.32)}
.sp-ico{
  width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:7px;flex-shrink:0;
  display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:14px;color:#fff;
  background:var(--sp-c, linear-gradient(160deg, #3b82f6, #1d4ed8));
  box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.28), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45);
}
.sp-ico.safari{background:linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f1f5f9 100%);color:#2563eb}
.sp-name{flex:1;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.sp-cat{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:rgba(255,255,255,.52)}
.sp-row.active .sp-cat{color:rgba(255,255,255,.92)}

/* DAY HERO */
#day{
  position:fixed;top:58px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;pointer-events:none;
  text-shadow:0 4px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);transition:opacity .7s ease .25s, transform .7s ease .25s;
}
body.booted #day{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
#day b{display:block;padding-left:.38em;font-size:clamp(28px,4.5vw,56px);font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.38em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.95)}
#day span{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78)}

/* WIDGETS */
#widgets{
  position:fixed;top:52px;right:16px;z-index:3;width:308px;display:grid;gap:12px;
  max-height:calc(100% - 155px);overflow:auto;scrollbar-width:none;
  opacity:0;transform:translateX(16px);transition:opacity .7s ease .3s, transform .7s ease .3s;
}
body.booted #widgets{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0)}
.wg{padding:8px;border-radius:22px;background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:var(--blur);-webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--blur);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.wg>header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 12px;font-weight:600;font-size:13px}
.wg>header button{margin-left:auto;width:26px;height:26px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:none;color:var(--mut);transition:transform .25s,background .15s}
.wg>header button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:var(--txt)}
.wg.shut>header button{transform:rotate(180deg)}.wg.shut .ul{display:none}
.u{margin:6px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:15px;background:var(--glass-card);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.u small{color:var(--mut);font-size:11px;font-weight:500}.u b{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}.u p{margin-top:4px;color:var(--mut);font-size:12px}.u ul{margin:6px 0 0 18px;color:var(--mut);font-size:12px}

/* DOCK */
#dock{
  position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:14px;translate:-50% 0;z-index:16;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:10px 14px 12px;border-radius:24px;
  background:rgba(24,30,38,.52);
  backdrop-filter:blur(34px) saturate(190%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(34px) saturate(190%);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  box-shadow:0 22px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.55), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25);
  transform:translateY(120%);transition:transform .65s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) .2s;
}
body.booted #dock{transform:translateY(0)}
body.in-fullscreen #dock{transform:translateY(150%)!important;opacity:0!important;visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}
.dk{
  position:relative;width:50px;height:50px;padding:0;border:0;background:none;
  transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.25,1.2);
}
.dk .ti{
  width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;
  border-radius:15px;color:#fff;
  background:var(--tile-bg, linear-gradient(160deg, #38bdf8, #0284c7));
  border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.32), inset 0 1.5px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.55);
  transition:filter .18s, box-shadow .18s;
}
.dk:hover .ti{
  filter:brightness(1.08);
  box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.42), inset 0 1.5px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.75);
}
.dk .ic{font-size:22px;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.22))}
.dk:hover,.dk:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-8px) scale(1.13)}
.dk:active{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.03)}
.dk.start-dk .ti{background:linear-gradient(180deg, #161822 0%, #090a0f 100%);color:#ffffff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.32)}
.dk.start-dk .ic{filter:none}
.dk::before{
  content:attr(data-tip);position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 12px);left:50%;translate:-50% 0;
  padding:5px 10px;border-radius:8px;
  background:var(--glass-heavy);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--txt);
  font-size:11px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
  box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35);transition:opacity .15s, transform .15s;transform:translateY(4px);
}
.dk:hover::before,.dk:focus-visible::before{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.dk::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-7px;left:50%;width:4.5px;height:4.5px;margin-left:-2.25px;
  border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);opacity:0;transition:.15s;
}
.dk.open::after{opacity:.75}
.dk.act::after{opacity:1;background:#60a5fa;box-shadow:0 0 6px #60a5fa}
.sep{align-self:stretch;width:1px;margin:4px 2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}

/* LAUNCHPAD */
#startMenu{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:14;
  background:rgba(12,15,24,.38);
  backdrop-filter:blur(44px) saturate(185%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(44px) saturate(185%);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;
  padding:54px 24px 108px;
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .32s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), visibility 0s .32s, backdrop-filter .32s ease;
}
#startMenu.open{
  opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto;
  transition:opacity .32s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), visibility 0s 0s, backdrop-filter .32s ease;
}
.lp-inner{
  width:min(860px,92vw);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:42px;
  transform:scale(1.08);
  transition:transform .36s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
}
#startMenu.open .lp-inner{transform:scale(1)}
.lp-search{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  width:min(270px,80vw);height:32px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:8px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
}
.lp-search input{flex:1;border:0;background:none;outline:none;font-size:13px;color:#fff;text-align:center}
.lp-search input:focus{text-align:left}
.lp-search input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.62)}
.lp-grid{
  width:100%;max-height:calc(100vh - 210px);overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:none;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:34px 20px;
  justify-items:center;padding:8px;
}
.lp-item{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  background:none;border:0;padding:6px;border-radius:18px;width:110px;
  transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.25,1.2);
}
.lp-item:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.06)}
.lp-ico{
  width:74px;height:74px;border-radius:19px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:32px;
  background:var(--c, linear-gradient(160deg, #38bdf8, #0284c7));
  border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.34);
  box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35), inset 0 1.5px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.55);
}
.lp-ico .ic{font-size:36px!important;line-height:1}
.lp-item span{
  font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
  max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;
}

/* WINDOWS */
#desk{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:6;pointer-events:none}
.win{
  position:absolute;pointer-events:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  min-width:360px;min-height:260px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.12) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.03) 45%, rgba(255,255,255,.06) 100%),
    rgba(18,22,33,.62);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(48px) saturate(210%);
  backdrop-filter: blur(48px) saturate(210%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.24);
  box-shadow:
    0 36px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.52),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.32);
  animation:pop .24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
  transition:box-shadow .2s,opacity .2s,transform .2s;
}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.95) translateY(10px)}}
.win.focus{
  box-shadow:
    0 40px 110px rgba(0,0,0,.60),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(180,205,255,.32),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.38);
}
.win.min{opacity:0;transform:scale(.82) translateY(50px);pointer-events:none;visibility:hidden}
.win.max{left:0!important;top:32px!important;width:100%!important;height:calc(100% - 32px - 86px)!important;border-radius:0}
body.in-fullscreen .win.max{top:0!important;height:100%!important}
.tb{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:80px 1fr 80px;align-items:center;height:40px;padding:0 14px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.12), rgba(255,255,255,.03)), rgba(20,24,36,.45);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(190%);
  backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(190%);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  cursor:grab;touch-action:none;user-select:none;
}
.wb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.wb button{width:13px;height:13px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:50%;transition:transform .15s,filter .15s;position:relative}
.wb button:hover{transform:scale(1.12);filter:brightness(1.1)}
.wb .b-c{background:#ff5f57}
.wb .b-m{background:#febc2e}
.wb .b-x{background:#28c840}
.tt{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;color:var(--txt)}
.tt .ic{font-size:13px;color:var(--acc)}
.wbody{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.018)}
.wbody iframe{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;background:transparent}
.ph{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;display:grid;place-content:center;justify-items:center;gap:12px;padding:20px;text-align:center;color:var(--mut);background:var(--glass-heavy);backdrop-filter:blur(24px)}
.rs{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:2;width:18px;height:18px;cursor:nwse-resize;touch-action:none}
#desk.drag iframe{pointer-events:none}

/* MENU DROPDOWN */
#menu,#userMenu{
  position:fixed;z-index:30;min-width:236px;padding:6px;border-radius:14px;
  background:var(--glass-heavy);backdrop-filter:var(--blur);-webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--blur);
  border:1px solid var(--line-bright);box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  animation:pop .16s ease;
}
#menu button,#userMenu button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:8px 12px;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:none;text-align:left;font-size:12.5px;transition:background .12s}
#menu button:hover,#userMenu button:hover{background:rgba(43,127,255,.24)}
#menu hr,#userMenu hr{margin:5px 8px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}#menu .ic,#userMenu .ic{width:16px;text-align:center;color:var(--acc)}

/* SETTINGS APP */
.st-shell{display:grid;grid-template-columns:196px 1fr;height:100%;background:transparent}
.st-side{
  padding:16px 12px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;
}
.st-nav{
  flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 13px;border:0;border-radius:11px;
  background:none;text-align:left;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);transition:all .15s;
}
.st-nav:hover{background:var(--glass-card);color:var(--txt)}
.st-nav.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.11);color:var(--txt);font-weight:600;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.st-nav .ic{width:16px;text-align:center;color:var(--acc)}
.st-main{padding:26px 28px;overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:thin}
.st-heading{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:6px}
.st-sub{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-bottom:20px}
.st-grid-2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
.st-card{
  padding:18px 20px;border-radius:16px;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.06),rgba(255,255,255,.015)),rgba(255,255,255,.035);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
  margin-bottom:14px;transition:border-color .18s, background .18s;
}
.st-card:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.24);background:rgba(255,255,255,.065)}
.st-card h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.st-card p{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:14px}
.st-card code{padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px}
.st-btn-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.st-presets{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.st-preset-chip{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 13px;border-radius:11px;
  background:var(--glass-card);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;transition:all .15s;
}
.st-preset-chip:hover{background:var(--glass-card-hover);border-color:var(--acc);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.st-preset-chip img{width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:3px}
.st-field{margin-top:12px}
.st-field label{display:block;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);margin-bottom:5px}
.st-field input,.st-field select{
  width:100%;height:36px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:rgba(12,16,26,.22);color:var(--txt);
}
.theme-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
.theme-card{
  padding:14px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--glass-card);
  text-align:left;transition:.16s;
}
.theme-card:hover{border-color:var(--line-bright);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.theme-card.selected{border-color:var(--acc);background:rgba(43,127,255,.16)}
.theme-swatch{height:34px;border-radius:9px;margin-bottom:9px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.wp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:10px}
.wp-item{
  height:92px;border-radius:13px;border:2px solid var(--line);background-size:cover;background-position:center;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:.18s;
}
.wp-item:hover{border-color:var(--acc);transform:scale(1.02)}
.wp-item span{
  position:absolute;bottom:6px;left:8px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:6px;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);color:#fff;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:500;
}

/* NATIVE APPS */
.calc-app{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%;padding:14px;gap:10px;background:rgba(15,18,26,.65);user-select:none}
.calc-disp{
  height:74px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:14px;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:flex-end;overflow:hidden;
}
.calc-expr{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);min-height:16px}
.calc-val{font-size:34px;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.1;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.calc-grid{flex:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px}
.calc-btn{border:0;border-radius:12px;font-size:18px;font-weight:500;background:rgba(255,255,255,.11);color:#fff;transition:filter .12s, transform .1s}
.calc-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.18)}.calc-btn:active{transform:scale(.95)}
.calc-btn.fn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);color:#fff}
.calc-btn.op{background:#ff9f0a;color:#fff;font-size:20px}
.calc-btn.zero{grid-column:span 2;text-align:left;padding-left:24px}

.notes-app{display:grid;grid-template-columns:210px 1fr;height:100%}
.notes-side{border-right:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:10px;gap:8px}
.notes-list{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.note-item{width:100%;padding:9px 11px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:none;text-align:left;transition:background .12s}
.note-item:hover{background:var(--glass-card)}
.note-item.active{background:rgba(251,191,36,.22);border:1px solid rgba(251,191,36,.4)}
.note-item b{display:block;font-size:12.5px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.note-item small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--mut);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;margin-top:2px}
.notes-editor{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:16px 20px;gap:10px}
.notes-title-in{border:0;background:none;outline:none;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:var(--txt);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:8px}
.notes-body-in{flex:1;border:0;background:none;outline:none;resize:none;font:13.5px/1.6 'Inter',sans-serif;color:var(--txt)}

.paint-app{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%}
.paint-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.paint-swatch{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);transition:transform .12s}
.paint-swatch.active{transform:scale(1.18);border-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--acc)}
.paint-canvas-wrap{flex:1;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#ffffff;cursor:crosshair}
.paint-canvas-wrap canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;touch-action:none}

.weather-app{
  height:100%;padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(14,116,144,.45), rgba(30,58,138,.55));
}
.weather-main{text-align:center;margin-top:8px}
.weather-main i{font-size:46px;color:#fde047;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 18px rgba(250,204,21,.4))}
.weather-temp{font-size:58px;font-weight:200;line-height:1.05;margin-top:8px}
.weather-cond{font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
.weather-loc{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:2px}
.weather-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}
.weather-card{padding:12px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);text-align:center}
.weather-card small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--mut);letter-spacing:.08em}
.weather-card b{display:block;font-size:15px;margin-top:4px}

.music-app{
  height:100%;padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(190,18,60,.35), rgba(15,23,42,.75));
}
.music-art{
  width:136px;height:136px;border-radius:22px;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg, #fb7185, #e11d48);
  font-size:52px;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(225,29,72,.4);
}
.music-meta{text-align:center}
.music-meta h3{font-size:18px;font-weight:700}
.music-meta p{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:2px}
.music-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.music-btn{
  width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:15px;
  transition:transform .14s, background .14s;
}
.music-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);transform:scale(1.06)}
.music-btn.play{width:54px;height:54px;background:#fff;color:#111827;font-size:18px}

.term-app{
  height:100%;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  background:rgba(9,11,16,.88);font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:12.5px;color:#4ade80;
}
.term-output{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;line-height:1.5}
.term-input-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.term-input-row span{color:#38bdf8;white-space:nowrap}
.term-input-row input{flex:1;border:0;background:none;outline:none;color:#f8fafc;font-family:inherit;font-size:inherit}

.clock-app{
  height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, rgba(56,189,248,.16), rgba(9,13,22,.82));
}
.clock-big{font-size:48px;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.03em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.clock-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}


/* CONTROL CENTER */
#cc{position:fixed;top:36px;right:10px;z-index:28;width:332px;padding:12px;border-radius:22px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;
  background:var(--glass-heavy);backdrop-filter:var(--blur);-webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--blur);border:1px solid var(--line-bright);box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateY(-8px) scale(.97);transform-origin:top right;
  transition:opacity .2s ease,transform .22s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),visibility 0s .22s}
#cc.open{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:none;transition:opacity .2s ease,transform .22s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),visibility 0s 0s}
body.in-fullscreen #cc{display:none}
.cc-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;min-width:0;padding:5px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:none;text-align:left}
.cc-row:hover{background:var(--glass-card-hover)}
.cc-tile{padding:10px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--glass-card);border:1px solid var(--line)}
button.cc-tile:hover{background:var(--glass-card-hover)}
.cc-net{grid-row:span 2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-around;padding:6px}
.cc-pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.cc-sq{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 4px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.2}
.cc-dot{flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border:0;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:13px;color:#fff;background:rgba(128,136,150,.45);transition:background .2s}
.on>.cc-dot,.cc-mute.on{background:var(--acc)}
#ccDnd.on>.cc-dot{background:var(--acc2)}
#ccNight.on>.cc-dot{background:#f59e0b}
.cc-row b,.cc-meta b{display:block;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2}
.cc-row small,.cc-meta small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap}
.cc-sl,.cc-np{grid-column:1/-1}
.cc-h{display:block;margin:0 0 7px 2px;padding:0;border:0;background:none;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.cc-h:hover{color:var(--acc)}
.cc-snd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.cc-snd .cc-rw{flex:1}
.cc-rw{position:relative}
.cc-rw>i{position:absolute;left:9px;top:50%;translate:0 -50%;z-index:1;font-size:12px;color:#5b6578;pointer-events:none;width:14px;text-align:center}
.cc-range{--f:1;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;display:block;width:100%;height:26px;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff calc(13px + (100% - 26px) * var(--f)),rgba(128,136,150,.38) calc(13px + (100% - 26px) * var(--f)))}
.cc-range::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.cc-range::-moz-range-thumb{width:26px;height:26px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.cc-np{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.cc-art{flex:none;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e293b,#0b1020);color:var(--acc);font-size:16px}
.cc-meta{flex:1;min-width:0}
.cc-meta b,.cc-meta small{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.cc-np>button{flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:none;font-size:14px}
.cc-np>button:hover{background:var(--glass-card-hover)}
#dim,#warm{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:0}
#dim{z-index:99999;background:#000;transition:opacity .08s}
#warm{z-index:99998;background:#ff9d4d;mix-blend-mode:multiply;transition:opacity .5s}

/* FIRST-TIME GUIDE MODAL (GLASS UI) */
#firstRunGuide {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 99995;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity .3s ease, visibility 0s .3s;
}
#firstRunGuide.open {
  opacity: 1; visibility: visible; pointer-events: auto;
  transition: opacity .3s ease, visibility 0s 0s;
}
#firstRunCard {
  width: min(440px, 92vw); border-radius: 24px; padding: 28px;
  background: var(--glass-heavy);
  backdrop-filter: var(--blur);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--blur);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-bright);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  color: var(--txt); transform: scale(.94) translateY(10px);
  transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
}
#firstRunGuide.open #firstRunCard {
  transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
}

/* MENU BAR DROPDOWNS (GLASS UI) */
#menu, #userMenu, #helpMenu {
  position: fixed; z-index: 30; min-width: 236px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--glass-heavy) !important;
  backdrop-filter: var(--blur) !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--blur) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-bright) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow) !important;
  animation: pop .16s ease;
  color: var(--txt);
}
#menu button, #userMenu button, #helpMenu button {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px;
  background: none; text-align: left; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--txt); transition: background .12s;
}
#menu button:hover, #userMenu button:hover, #helpMenu button:hover { background: rgba(43,127,255,.24); }
#menu hr, #userMenu hr, #helpMenu hr { margin: 5px 8px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
#menu .ic, #userMenu .ic, #helpMenu .ic { width: 16px; text-align: center; color: var(--acc); }

/* MENU BAR USER + STATUS */
#top button.top-user{padding:0 8px 0 5px;max-width:130px}
#topUserName{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:84px}
.top-av{flex:none;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--acc),var(--acc2))}
.top-status{width:22px;height:22px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.um-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 10px}
.um-av{width:32px;height:32px;font-size:14px}
.um-head b{display:block;font-size:13px}
.um-head small{color:var(--mut);font-size:11px}
@media(max-width:640px){#topUserName{display:none}#top button.top-user{padding:0 6px}#cc{width:min(332px,calc(100vw - 20px))}}

/* SETTINGS ROWS & SWITCHES */
.st-card>.st-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.st-card>.st-row:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
.st-card>.st-row:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.st-row b{font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.st-card .st-row p{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:12px}
.st-rg{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr}
.sw{flex:none;position:relative;width:42px;height:25px;border:0;border-radius:13px;background:rgba(128,136,150,.45);transition:background .2s}
.sw::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:21px;height:21px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35);transition:transform .2s}
.sw.on{background:var(--acc)}
.sw.on::after{transform:translateX(17px)}

/* ACCESSIBILITY SWITCHES */
body.reduce-motion *,body.reduce-motion *::before,body.reduce-motion *::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}
body.reduce-trans{--glass:rgba(24,28,40,.97);--glass-heavy:rgba(20,24,36,.98);--bar:rgba(22,26,38,.98)}
body.reduce-trans[data-theme="crystal"]{--glass:rgba(244,246,252,.97);--glass-heavy:rgba(248,250,255,.98);--bar:rgba(250,252,255,.98)}
body.reduce-trans *{backdrop-filter:none!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important}
body.reduce-trans #top{background:rgba(18,22,32,.98)}

/* TOAST */
#toast{
  position:fixed;top:44px;right:18px;z-index:100;
  padding:10px 16px;border-radius:14px;
  background:var(--glass-heavy);backdrop-filter:blur(30px) saturate(185%);
  border:1px solid var(--line-bright);box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(-10px);pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .25s ease, transform .25s ease;
}
#toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}

/* DIALOGS */
dialog{margin:auto;width:min(92vw,400px);padding:22px;border-radius:20px;color:var(--txt);background:var(--glass-heavy);backdrop-filter:blur(30px) saturate(185%);border:1px solid var(--line-bright);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
dialog h2{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}
dialog label{display:block;margin-top:12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
dialog input{width:100%;height:36px;margin-top:5px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.row{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:18px}
.acts{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:14px}.acts .ib{height:36px;justify-content:flex-start}
#wp-msg{min-height:18px;margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;color:#ffb4a8}
#doc{width:min(92vw,560px)}
#doc-b{max-height:55vh;margin-top:8px;padding-right:6px;overflow:auto}
#doc-b h3{margin:14px 0 4px;font-size:13px}
#doc-b p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;line-height:1.55}

@media(max-width:900px){#widgets{display:none}}
@media(max-width:720px){
  #day b{letter-spacing:.2em;padding-left:.2em}
  .dk{width:44px;height:44px}
  .top-menu-item{display:none!important}
  .lp-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px 12px}
  .lp-ico{width:62px;height:62px;font-size:26px;border-radius:16px}
  .st-shell{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .st-side{flex-direction:row;overflow-x:auto;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- AUTHENTIC MACOS "HELLO" STARTUP & SETUP WIZARD SCREEN -->
<div id="boot" aria-hidden="true">
  <div id="boot-wall-blur"></div>

  <!-- Stage 1: Hello cursive animation -->
  <div class="hello-stage" id="bootHelloStage">
    <svg class="hello-svg" viewBox="0 0 420 150" role="img" aria-label="hello">
      <path class="hello-stroke" pathLength="1" d="
        M 28 108
        C 50 96, 80 40, 80 22
        C 80 12, 66 14, 60 34
        C 52 62, 46 104, 46 112
        C 52 90, 70 72, 86 72
        C 98 72, 102 84, 98 100
        C 95 110, 104 114, 118 106
        C 136 96, 152 82, 148 72
        C 144 64, 128 70, 124 90
        C 120 108, 136 116, 160 104
        C 186 90, 218 42, 218 22
        C 218 12, 204 14, 198 36
        C 190 66, 188 102, 200 110
        C 212 116, 238 94, 262 46
        C 272 26, 268 14, 258 20
        C 248 26, 240 70, 244 98
        C 248 114, 266 114, 284 96
        C 296 84, 308 72, 320 72
        C 302 72, 290 88, 294 104
        C 298 116, 318 116, 330 102
        C 340 90, 336 72, 320 72
        C 332 74, 356 72, 380 64
      " />
    </svg>
  </div>
  <button type="button" class="hello-start-btn" id="helloBtn">
    <span class="hello-start-ico"><i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right"></i></span>
    <span>Get Started</span>
  </button>

  <!-- Stage 2: Create a Computer Account -->
  <div class="setup-step" id="setupAccountCard" hidden>
    <h2>Create a Computer Account</h2>
    <p class="setup-desc">Fill out the following information to create your account. A password is optional.</p>
    <div class="setup-table">
      <div class="setup-row">
        <label for="setupName">Full name</label>
        <input id="setupName" type="text" placeholder="Required" autocomplete="name">
      </div>
      <div class="setup-row">
        <label for="setupPass">Password</label>
        <input id="setupPass" type="password" placeholder="Optional" autocomplete="new-password">
      </div>
      <div class="setup-row" id="rowVerify" hidden>
        <label for="setupVerify">Verify</label>
        <input id="setupVerify" type="password" placeholder="Required" autocomplete="new-password">
      </div>
      <div class="setup-row" id="rowHint" hidden>
        <label for="setupHint">Hint</label>
        <input id="setupHint" type="text" placeholder="Recommended">
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="setup-footnote">This password only locks the desktop in this browser.</div>
    <div class="setup-continue-row">
      <button type="button" class="setup-pill-btn" id="setupAccountNext">Continue</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Stage 3: Choose Your Look -->
  <div class="setup-step" id="setupLookCard" hidden>
    <h2>Choose Your Look</h2>
    <p class="setup-desc">Select an appearance and accent colour. You can change these later in Settings.</p>
    <div class="look-options">
      <button type="button" class="look-choice selected" data-theme="crystal">
        <div class="look-thumb light">
          <div class="lt-win"><div class="lt-dots"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div></div>
          <div class="lt-dock"></div>
        </div>
        <span>Light</span>
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="look-choice" data-theme="obsidian">
        <div class="look-thumb dark">
          <div class="lt-win"><div class="lt-dots"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div></div>
          <div class="lt-dock"></div>
        </div>
        <span>Dark</span>
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="look-choice" data-theme="glass">
        <div class="look-thumb auto">
          <div class="lt-win"><div class="lt-dots"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div></div>
          <div class="lt-dock"></div>
        </div>
        <span>Auto</span>
      </button>
    </div>
    <div class="accent-dots" id="setupSwatches">
      <button type="button" class="accent-dot selected" data-acc="#2b7fff" style="background:#2b7fff" aria-label="Blue"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i></button>
      <button type="button" class="accent-dot" data-acc="#9333ea" style="background:#9333ea" aria-label="Purple"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i></button>
      <button type="button" class="accent-dot" data-acc="#e11d48" style="background:#e11d48" aria-label="Rose"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i></button>
      <button type="button" class="accent-dot" data-acc="#ea580c" style="background:#ea580c" aria-label="Orange"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i></button>
      <button type="button" class="accent-dot" data-acc="#16a34a" style="background:#16a34a" aria-label="Green"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i></button>
      <button type="button" class="accent-dot" data-acc="#64748b" style="background:#64748b" aria-label="Graphite"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i></button>
    </div>
    <div class="setup-continue-row">
      <button type="button" class="setup-pill-btn" id="setupLookNext">Continue</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Stage 4: Welcome / Password Lock Screen -->
  <div class="setup-step" id="setupWelcomeCard" hidden>
    <div class="welcome-circle" id="setupAvatarInitial">F</div>
    <div class="welcome-title" id="setupWelcomeTitle">Welcome, user</div>
    <p class="welcome-sub" id="setupWelcomeSub">Your desktop will ask for your password each time it starts.</p>
    <div class="lock-login-box" id="lockLoginBox" hidden>
      <div class="lock-pass-pill" id="lockPassPill">
        <input id="lockPassInput" type="password" placeholder="Enter Password" autocomplete="current-password">
        <button type="button" class="lock-go-btn" id="lockUnlockBtn" aria-label="Unlock"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></button>
      </div>
      <div class="lock-hint-txt" id="lockHintTxt"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- FIRST-TIME LAUNCH GUIDE MODAL -->
<div id="firstRunGuide" aria-label="Welcome Guide">
  <div id="firstRunCard">
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:16px;">
      <span id="guideStepBadge" style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--glass-card);color:var(--txt);border:1px solid var(--line)">Step 1 of 4</span>
      <button type="button" id="guideSkipBtn" style="background:none;border:0;color:var(--mut);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;transition:color .2s">Skip</button>
    </div>
    <div id="guideStepBody" style="margin-bottom:22px;">
      <div id="guideIconWrap" style="width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#38bdf8,#0284c7);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:22px;color:#fff;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(2,132,199,.4)">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-compass"></i>
      </div>
      <h2 id="guideTitle" style="font-size:19px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--txt)">Welcome to SIFT macOS</h2>
      <p id="guideDesc" style="font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--mut);margin-bottom:14px">Your clean glassmorphic desktop is ready. Drag windows, open apps from the Dock, or use Spotlight.</p>
      <div style="padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--glass-card);border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--txt)">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-lightbulb" style="color:#fbbf24"></i>
        <span id="guideTipText">Tip: You can re-run this guide anytime from the top Help menu or Settings.</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)">
      <div id="guideDots" style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center">
        <button type="button" data-step="0" style="width:18px;height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--acc);border:0;cursor:pointer"></button>
        <button type="button" data-step="1" style="width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mut);border:0;cursor:pointer"></button>
        <button type="button" data-step="2" style="width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mut);border:0;cursor:pointer"></button>
        <button type="button" data-step="3" style="width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mut);border:0;cursor:pointer"></button>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px">
        <button type="button" id="guideBackBtn" class="ib" style="height:32px;padding:0 14px;font-size:12px" hidden>Back</button>
        <button type="button" id="guideNextBtn" class="ib primary" style="height:32px;padding:0 16px;font-size:12px">Next <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" style="font-size:10px;margin-left:4px"></i></button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- WALLPAPER -->
<div id="wall" aria-hidden="true"></div>

<!-- MISSION CONTROL WINDOW OVERVIEW EXPOSE -->
<div id="expose" aria-label="Mission Control Window Overview">
  <div class="ex-grid" id="exGrid"></div>
</div>

<!-- MACOS SPOTLIGHT SEARCH OVERLAY -->
<div id="spotlight" aria-label="Spotlight Search">
  <div class="sp-box">
    <div class="sp-input-row">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass"></i>
      <input id="spInput" type="text" placeholder="Spotlight Search" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
    </div>
    <div class="sp-results" id="spResults"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- AUTHENTIC MACOS TOP MENU BAR -->
<header id="top">
  <div class="top-left">
    <button type="button" id="menuBtn" class="brand-diamond" aria-label="System Menu" aria-haspopup="menu">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" rx="15" transform="rotate(45 50 50)" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="11"/>
        <rect x="38" y="38" width="24" height="24" rx="6" transform="rotate(45 50 50)" fill="currentColor"/>
      </svg>
    </button>
    <button type="button" class="top-active-app" id="topActiveApp">Finder</button>
    <button type="button" class="top-menu-item" id="topFileBtn">File</button>
    <button type="button" class="top-menu-item" id="topEditBtn">Edit</button>
    <button type="button" class="top-menu-item" id="topViewBtn">View</button>
    <button type="button" class="top-menu-item" id="topWindowBtn">Window</button>
    <button type="button" class="top-menu-item" id="topHelpBtn">Help</button>
  </div>
  <div class="top-right">
    <button type="button" class="top-user" id="topUser" aria-label="Account menu" aria-haspopup="menu" title="Your account"><span class="top-av" id="topAv">U</span><span id="topUserName">User</span></button>
    <span class="top-status" id="topDnd" hidden title="Do Not Disturb"><i class="fa-solid fa-moon"></i></span>
    <button type="button" class="top-icon-btn" id="topWifiBtn" aria-label="Wi-Fi Status" title="Connected">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-wifi"></i>
    </button>
    <button type="button" class="top-icon-btn" id="topSearchBtn" aria-label="Spotlight / Launchpad Search" title="Search Apps">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass"></i>
    </button>
    <button type="button" class="top-icon-btn" id="topCcBtn" aria-label="Control Center" aria-haspopup="dialog" title="Control Center">
      <svg class="cc-toggle-icon" viewBox="0 0 18 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5">
        <rect x="1.5" y="1.5" width="15" height="5" rx="2.5"/>
        <circle cx="13.5" cy="4" r="1.4" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>
        <rect x="1.5" y="9.5" width="15" height="5" rx="2.5"/>
        <circle cx="4.5" cy="12" r="1.4" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>
      </svg>
    </button>
    <span id="clock"></span>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- HELP MENU DROPDOWN -->
<div id="helpMenu" role="menu" hidden>
  <button type="button" id="helpReplayGuideBtn" role="menuitem"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-compass"></i>Desktop Quick Guide</button>
  <hr>
  <button type="button" data-doc="tos" role="menuitem"><i class="ic fa-regular fa-file-lines"></i>Terms of Service</button>
</div>

<!-- CENTER DATE / CLOCK HERO -->
<div id="day" aria-hidden="true"><b id="dayName"></b><span id="dateTxt"></span></div>

<!-- GLASS UPDATES WIDGET -->
<aside id="widgets" aria-label="Widgets">
  <section class="wg" id="upd">
    <header><i class="ic fa-regular fa-bell" style="color:var(--acc)"></i>Release Notes<button type="button" id="updBtn" aria-label="Collapse updates"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-chevron-up"></i></button></header>
    <div class="ul" id="updList"></div>
  </section>
</aside>

<!-- DESKTOP WINDOW LAYER -->
<main id="desk"></main>

<!-- MACOS LAUNCHPAD START MENU -->
<section id="startMenu" aria-label="Launchpad">
  <div class="lp-inner">
    <div class="lp-search">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass" style="color:rgba(255,255,255,.6)"></i>
      <input id="smSearch" type="search" placeholder="Search Apps" autocomplete="off">
    </div>
    <div class="lp-grid" id="lpGrid"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- MACOS GLASS DOCK -->
<nav id="dock" aria-label="Apps"></nav>

<!-- TOP BAR DROPDOWN MENU -->
<div id="menu" role="menu" hidden>
  <button role="menuitem" data-a="start"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-grip"></i>Open Launchpad</button>
  <button role="menuitem" data-a="expose"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-window-restore"></i>Mission Control (Open Windows)</button>
  <button role="menuitem" data-a="wall"><i class="ic fa-regular fa-image"></i>Change Wallpaper</button>
  <button role="menuitem" data-a="settings"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-gear"></i>System Settings</button>
  <hr>
  <button role="menuitem" data-a="ab"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-ghost"></i>Launch in about:blank</button>
  <button role="menuitem" data-a="blob"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-shield-halved"></i>Launch in Blob URL</button>
  <hr>
  <button role="menuitem" data-doc="tos"><i class="ic fa-regular fa-file-lines"></i>Terms of Service</button>
  <button role="menuitem" data-doc="privacy"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-user-shield"></i>Privacy Policy</button>
  <button role="menuitem" data-a="discord"><i class="ic fa-brands fa-discord"></i>Join our Discord</button>
</div>

<!-- SCREEN DIMMER & NIGHT SHIFT -->
<div id="warm" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<div id="dim" aria-hidden="true"></div>

<!-- CONTROL CENTER -->
<div id="cc" role="dialog" aria-label="Control Center">
  <div class="cc-tile cc-net">
    <button type="button" class="cc-row" id="ccWifi"><span class="cc-dot"><i class="fa-solid fa-wifi"></i></span><span><b>Wi-Fi</b><small id="ccWifiSub">SIFT Network</small></span></button>
    <button type="button" class="cc-row" id="ccBt"><span class="cc-dot"><i class="fa-brands fa-bluetooth-b"></i></span><span><b>Bluetooth</b><small id="ccBtSub">On</small></span></button>
    <button type="button" class="cc-row" id="ccAir"><span class="cc-dot"><i class="fa-solid fa-tower-broadcast"></i></span><span><b>AirDrop</b><small id="ccAirSub">Contacts Only</small></span></button>
  </div>
  <button type="button" class="cc-tile cc-row" id="ccDnd"><span class="cc-dot"><i class="fa-solid fa-moon"></i></span><span><b>Do Not Disturb</b></span></button>
  <div class="cc-pair">
    <button type="button" class="cc-tile cc-sq" id="ccNight"><span class="cc-dot"><i class="fa-solid fa-sun"></i></span><span>Night Shift</span></button>
    <button type="button" class="cc-tile cc-sq" id="ccFull"><span class="cc-dot"><i class="fa-solid fa-expand"></i></span><span>Full Screen</span></button>
  </div>
  <div class="cc-tile cc-sl">
    <button type="button" class="cc-h" data-open="display">Display</button>
    <div class="cc-rw"><i class="fa-solid fa-sun"></i><input type="range" class="cc-range" id="ccBright" min="25" max="100" aria-label="Display brightness"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="cc-tile cc-sl">
    <button type="button" class="cc-h" data-open="sound">Sound</button>
    <div class="cc-snd">
      <div class="cc-rw"><i id="ccVolIco" class="fa-solid fa-volume-high"></i><input type="range" class="cc-range" id="ccVol" min="0" max="100" aria-label="Volume"></div>
      <button type="button" class="cc-dot cc-mute" id="ccMute" aria-label="Mute"><i class="fa-solid fa-volume-xmark"></i></button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="cc-tile cc-np">
    <span class="cc-art"><i class="fa-solid fa-music"></i></span>
    <span class="cc-meta"><b id="ccTitle"></b><small id="ccArtist"></small></span>
    <button type="button" id="ccPlay" aria-label="Play or pause"></button>
    <button type="button" id="ccNext" aria-label="Next track"><i class="fa-solid fa-forward"></i></button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ACCOUNT MENU -->
<div id="userMenu" role="menu" hidden>
  <div class="um-head"><span class="top-av um-av" id="umAv">U</span><div><b id="umName">User</b><small>Local account</small></div></div>
  <hr>
  <button role="menuitem" data-u="acct"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-user-circle"></i>Account Settings</button>
  <button role="menuitem" data-u="sys"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-gear"></i>System Settings</button>
  <hr>
  <button role="menuitem" data-u="lock"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-lock"></i>Lock Screen</button>
</div>

<!-- TOAST -->
<div id="toast" role="status"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check" style="color:var(--acc)"></i><span id="toastTxt"></span></div>

<!-- WALLPAPER DIALOG -->
<dialog id="wp">
  <h2>Wallpaper</h2>
  <label>Image link<input id="wp-url" type="url" placeholder="https://example.com/wallpaper.jpg"></label>
  <div class="acts">
    <button type="button" class="ib primary" id="wp-apply"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Use this link</button>
    <button type="button" class="ib" id="wp-up"><i class="fa-solid fa-upload"></i> Upload an image</button>
  </div>
  <div class="acts">
    <button type="button" class="ib" id="wp-p1"><i class="fa-regular fa-image"></i> Default Alpine Vista</button>
    <button type="button" class="ib" id="wp-p2"><i class="fa-regular fa-image"></i> Sunset Peak</button>
  </div>
  <input id="wp-file" type="file" accept="image/*" hidden>
  <p id="wp-msg" role="status"></p>
  <div class="row"><button type="button" class="ib" id="wp-reset">Reset</button><button type="button" class="ib" id="wp-x">Close</button></div>
</dialog>

<!-- DOCS DIALOG -->
<dialog id="doc"><h2 id="doc-t"></h2><div id="doc-b"></div><div class="row"><button type="button" class="ib" id="doc-x">Close</button></div></dialog>

<script>
"use strict";
const BASE = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Shazam123abc/sh0zy@main/";
const LINKS = { discord: "https://discord.com/invite/2zZTRMZPa4" };

  { name: "Canva", title: "Home - Canva", icon: "https://static.canva.com/static/images/favicon-1.ico" },
