];
const UPDATES = [
  { date: "2026-11-13", tag: "macOS Sonoma", title: "Setup Assistant & Auto Fullscreen Hide", text: "Added macOS account setup wizard, Weather, Music, Terminal apps, and automatic top bar/dock hiding in fullscreen.", bullets: ["macOS Hello & Account Setup Wizard", "Weather, Music & Terminal apps", "Auto-hide top bar & dock in fullscreen"] }
];
const FWD = '<script>addEventListener("keydown",function(e){if(e.shiftKey&&e.altKey&&e.code==="KeyA"){e.preventDefault();parent.postMessage({sh:"key",key:"admin"},"*")}})<\/script>';
const ICONS = {
  gamepad:'fa-solid fa-gamepad', games:'fa-solid fa-gamepad', chat:'fa-regular fa-comment-dots',
  robot:'fa-solid fa-robot', ai:'fa-solid fa-robot', discord:'fa-brands fa-discord',
  settings:'fa-solid fa-gear', reload:'fa-solid fa-rotate-right', download:'fa-solid fa-download',
  upload:'fa-solid fa-upload', image:'fa-regular fa-image',
  paint:'fa-solid fa-paintbrush', calculator:'fa-solid fa-calculator', notes:'fa-solid fa-note-sticky',
  weather:'fa-solid fa-cloud-sun', music:'fa-solid fa-music', terminal:'fa-solid fa-terminal', clock:'fa-solid fa-clock'
};
const ico = n => '<i class="ic ' + (/^fa-[\w -]+$/.test(n) ? n : ICONS[n] || 'fa-solid fa-window-maximize') + '" aria-hidden="true"></i>';
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const h = (tag, props = {}, ...kids) => { const n = Object.assign(document.createElement(tag), props); n.append(...kids); return n; };
const ls = {
  get(k, d = "") { try { return localStorage.getItem(k) ?? d; } catch { return d; } },
  set(k, v) { try { localStorage.setItem(k, v); } catch {} },
  del(k) { try { localStorage.removeItem(k); } catch {} }
};

let pages = [], focused = null, zTop = 10, toastTimer = null, spIndex = 0, spItems = [];
const apps = new Map(), cache = new Map(), wins = new Map(), dockBtns = new Map();
const desk = $("desk"), menu = $("menu"), startMenu = $("startMenu"), expose = $("expose"), spotlight = $("spotlight");
const slugOf = p => p.file.replace(/\.html$/, "");

function notify(msg) {
  if (SYS.dnd) return;
  $("toastTxt").textContent = msg;
  $("toast").classList.add("show");
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => $("toast").classList.remove("show"), 2600);
}

function launchAboutBlank() {
  const win = window.open("about:blank", "_blank");
  if (!win) { notify("Popup blocked! Allow popups for about:blank."); return; }
  const doc = win.document;
  doc.open();
  doc.write(`<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>${document.title || "My Drive - Google Drive"}</title><link rel="icon" href="${$("fav").href}"><style>html,body,iframe{margin:0;padding:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;overflow:hidden;background:#07080c}</style></head><body><iframe src="${location.href}" allowfullscreen></iframe></body></html>`);
  doc.close();
  notify("Opened in about:blank tab!");
}

function launchBlob() {
  try {
    const html = "<!DOCTYPE html>\n" + document.documentElement.outerHTML;
    const blob = new Blob([html], { type: "text/html" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const win = window.open(url, "_blank");
    if (!win) { notify("Popup blocked! Allow popups for Blob."); return; }
    notify("Opened in Blob URL!");
  } catch { notify("Could not create Blob session."); }
}

async function getPage(file, fresh) {
  if (!/^[\w-]+\.html$/.test(file)) throw new Error("bad file");
  if (!fresh && cache.has(file)) return cache.get(file);
  const r = await fetch(BASE + file, { cache: fresh ? "reload" : "default" });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status);
  const t = await r.text(); cache.set(file, t); return t;
}

function setWall() {
  const custom = ls.get("sh0zy.bg");
  const activeWall = custom || FORCED_WALLPAPER;
  $("wall").style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + activeWall + '")';
  if ($("boot-wall-blur")) {
    $("boot-wall-blur").style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + activeWall + '")';
  }
}

function applySettings() {
  document.title = ls.get("sh0zy.title") || "SIFT";
  const f = ls.get("sh0zy.icon");
  const defaultBrandSvg = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><rect width="100" height="100" rx="22" fill="#07080c"/><rect x="22" y="22" width="56" height="56" rx="14" transform="rotate(45 50 50)" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="11"/><rect x="39" y="39" width="22" height="22" rx="6" transform="rotate(45 50 50)" fill="white"/></svg>';
  $("fav").href = !f ? ("data:image/svg+xml," + encodeURIComponent(defaultBrandSvg)) : /^https?:\/\//.test(f) ? f : "data:image/svg+xml," + encodeURIComponent('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><text y=".9em" font-size="90">' + f.replace(/[<>&]/g, "") + "</text></svg>");

  const acc = ls.get("sh0zy.acc") || "#2b7fff";
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--acc", acc);
  const theme = ls.get("sh0zy.theme") || "glass";
  document.body.dataset.theme = theme;
  $("day").style.display = ls.get("sh0zy.hidedate") === "1" ? "none" : "block";
  setWall();
}

/* ===== FIRST-TIME GUIDE LOGIC ===== */
const GUIDE_STEPS = [
  {
    icon: 'fa-solid fa-compass',
    gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #38bdf8, #0284c7)',
    title: 'Welcome to SIFT macOS',
    desc: 'Your clean, glassmorphic desktop workspace is ready. Drag windows by their titlebar, resize from the corner, or double-click desktop folders.',
    tip: 'You can customize wallpapers, accent colors, and appearance anytime in Settings.'
  },
  {
    icon: 'fa-solid fa-table-cells-large',
    gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #a855f7, #6366f1)',
    title: 'Dock & Launchpad',
    desc: 'Click any icon in the bottom Dock to launch Finder, Safari, Notes, Terminal, Music, and more—or open Launchpad to browse every app.',
    tip: 'Active apps show a subtle indicator dot underneath their Dock icon.'
  },
  {
    icon: 'fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass',
    gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #0ea5e9, #2563eb)',
    title: 'Instant Spotlight Search',
    desc: 'Press ⌘K (or Ctrl+K) anywhere, or click the search icon in the top-right menu bar to jump straight to apps or search the web.',
    tip: 'Try typing "Terminal" or "Calculator" in Spotlight and press Enter.'
  },
  {
    icon: 'fa-solid fa-sliders',
    gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981, #059669)',
    title: 'Control Center & Mission Control',
    desc: 'Toggle Wi-Fi, Night Shift, screen brightness, and volume from the top-right Control Center, or open Mission Control to view all windows.',
    tip: 'Click "Help" in the top menu bar anytime if you want to replay this guide.'
  }
];
let currentGuideStep = 0;

function renderGuideStep(idx) {
  currentGuideStep = Math.max(0, Math.min(GUIDE_STEPS.length - 1, idx));
  const step = GUIDE_STEPS[currentGuideStep];
  $("guideStepBadge").textContent = `Step ${currentGuideStep + 1} of ${GUIDE_STEPS.length}`;
  $("guideIconWrap").style.background = step.gradient;
  $("guideIconWrap").innerHTML = `<i class="${step.icon}"></i>`;
  $("guideTitle").textContent = step.title;
  $("guideDesc").textContent = step.desc;
  $("guideTipText").textContent = step.tip;

  Array.from($("guideDots").children).forEach((dot, i) => {
    if (i === currentGuideStep) {
      dot.style.width = "18px";
      dot.style.borderRadius = "3px";
      dot.style.background = "var(--acc)";
    } else {
      dot.style.width = "6px";
      dot.style.borderRadius = "50%";
      dot.style.background = "rgba(255,255,255,.3)";
    }
  });

  const backBtn = $("guideBackBtn"), nextBtn = $("guideNextBtn");
  backBtn.hidden = currentGuideStep === 0;
  if (currentGuideStep === GUIDE_STEPS.length - 1) {
    nextBtn.innerHTML = 'Get Started <i class="fa-solid fa-check" style="font-size:10px;margin-left:4px"></i>';
  } else {
    nextBtn.innerHTML = 'Next <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" style="font-size:10px;margin-left:4px"></i>';
  }
}

function openFirstRunGuide(startStep = 0) {
  renderGuideStep(startStep);
  $("firstRunGuide").classList.add("open");
}

function closeFirstRunGuide() {
  ls.set("sift.guideDone", "1");
  $("firstRunGuide").classList.remove("open");
}

$("guideSkipBtn").onclick = closeFirstRunGuide;
$("guideBackBtn").onclick = () => renderGuideStep(currentGuideStep - 1);
$("guideNextBtn").onclick = () => {
  if (currentGuideStep < GUIDE_STEPS.length - 1) renderGuideStep(currentGuideStep + 1);
  else closeFirstRunGuide();
};
Array.from($("guideDots").children).forEach(dot => {
  dot.onclick = () => renderGuideStep(parseInt(dot.dataset.step, 10));
});
$("helpReplayGuideBtn").onclick = () => {
  $("helpMenu").hidden = true;
  openFirstRunGuide(0);
};

/* ===== FULLSCREEN DOCK & TOP BAR AUTO-HIDE ===== */
let fullscreenButtonMode = false;
function syncFullscreenState() {
  // Hide the desktop bars for an app window maximized with its green button
  // or the in-app fullscreen control. Browser F11 alone should not trigger it.
  const apiFullscreen = !!(
    document.fullscreenElement ||
    document.webkitFullscreenElement ||
    document.mozFullScreenElement ||
    document.msFullscreenElement
  );
  const maximizedWindow = !!document.querySelector(".win.max:not(.min)");
  const active = apiFullscreen || fullscreenButtonMode || maximizedWindow;
  document.body.classList.toggle("in-fullscreen", active);
}
["fullscreenchange", "webkitfullscreenchange", "mozfullscreenchange", "MSFullscreenChange"].forEach(ev => {
  document.addEventListener(ev, syncFullscreenState);
});
window.addEventListener("resize", syncFullscreenState);
window.addEventListener("orientationchange", syncFullscreenState);
syncFullscreenState();

/* ===== MISSION CONTROL WINDOW OVERVIEW (EXPOSE) ===== */
function toggleExpose(force) {
  const isOpen = expose.classList.contains("open");
  const show = typeof force === "boolean" ? force : !isOpen;
  if (show) {
    menu.hidden = true;
    $("helpMenu").hidden = true;
    toggleStartMenu(false);
    toggleSpotlight(false);
    renderExpose();
    expose.classList.add("open");
  } else {
    expose.classList.remove("open");
  }
}

function renderExpose() {
  const list = [...wins.values()];
  if (list.length === 0) {
    $("exGrid").replaceChildren(
      h("div", { style: "grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:48px 20px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);" },
        h("i", { className: "fa-regular fa-window-restore", style: "font-size:38px;margin-bottom:12px;opacity:.55;display:block" }),
        h("div", { style: "font-size:17px;font-weight:600;color:#fff", textContent: "No Open Windows" }),
        h("div", { style: "font-size:12.5px;margin-top:4px;opacity:.7", textContent: "Open an app from the Dock or Launchpad to see it here." })
      )
    );
    return;
  }

  $("exGrid").replaceChildren(...list.map((w, idx) => {
    const item = h("div", { className: "ex-item" });
    const closeBtn = h("button", {
      type: "button",
      className: "ex-close-btn",
      title: "Close " + w.app.name,
      "aria-label": "Close " + w.app.name,
      onclick: e => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        closeWin(w);
        renderExpose();
      }
    }, h("i", { className: "fa-solid fa-xmark" }));

    const box = h("div", { className: "ex-win-box" });
    const chrome = h("div", { className: "ex-win-chrome" },
      h("span", { className: "ex-dot r" }),
      h("span", { className: "ex-dot y" }),
      h("span", { className: "ex-dot g" })
    );
    const body = h("div", { className: "ex-win-body" });
    const srcW = Math.max(360, w.el.offsetWidth || 760);
    const srcH = Math.max(260, w.el.offsetHeight || 520);
    const stage = h("div", { className: "ex-preview-stage" });
    stage.style.width = srcW + "px";
    stage.style.height = srcH + "px";

    const clone = w.el.cloneNode(true);
    clone.classList.remove("min", "max");
    clone.style.width = srcW + "px";
    clone.style.height = srcH + "px";

    const origCanvases = w.el.querySelectorAll("canvas");
    const cloneCanvases = clone.querySelectorAll("canvas");
    origCanvases.forEach((origC, ci) => {
      const destC = cloneCanvases[ci];
      if (destC && origC.width && origC.height) {
        destC.width = origC.width;
        destC.height = origC.height;
        const ctx = destC.getContext("2d");
        if (ctx) ctx.drawImage(origC, 0, 0);
      }
    });

    clone.querySelectorAll("iframe").forEach(ifr => {
      const fallback = h("div", {
        style: `width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;background:${tileGradient(w.app.key, idx)};color:#fff;`
      });
      fallback.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:68px;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35))">${ico(w.app.icon || "settings")}</div><div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em">${w.app.name}</div>`;
      ifr.replaceWith(fallback);
    });

    stage.append(clone);
    body.append(stage);
    box.append(chrome, body);

    const label = h("div", { className: "ex-label", textContent: w.app.name });
    item.append(closeBtn, box, label);
    item.onclick = () => {
      toggleExpose(false);
      focusWin(w);
    };
    return item;
  }));

  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    $("exGrid").querySelectorAll(".ex-win-body").forEach(body => {
      const stage = body.querySelector(".ex-preview-stage");
      if (!stage) return;
      const bw = body.clientWidth || 280;
      const bh = body.clientHeight || 170;
      const sw = parseFloat(stage.style.width) || 760;
      const sh = parseFloat(stage.style.height) || 520;
      const scale = Math.min(bw / sw, bh / sh);
      const offsetX = Math.max(0, (bw - sw * scale) / 2);
      const offsetY = Math.max(0, (bh - sh * scale) / 2);
      stage.style.transform = `translate(${offsetX}px, ${offsetY}px) scale(${scale})`;
    });
  });
}

/* ===== MACOS LAUNCHPAD START MENU ===== */
function toggleStartMenu(force) {
  const isOpen = startMenu.classList.contains("open");
  const show = typeof force === "boolean" ? force : !isOpen;
  if (show) {
    menu.hidden = true;
    $("helpMenu").hidden = true;
    toggleExpose(false);
    toggleSpotlight(false);
    $("smSearch").value = "";
    renderStartMenu("");
    startMenu.classList.add("open");
    setTimeout(() => $("smSearch").focus(), 60);
  } else {
    startMenu.classList.remove("open");
  }
}

const APP_TILE_GRADIENTS = [
  "linear-gradient(160deg, #38bdf8 0%, #0284c7 100%)",
  "linear-gradient(160deg, #60a5fa 0%, #2563eb 100%)",
  "linear-gradient(160deg, #e879f9 0%, #8b5cf6 52%, #3b82f6 100%)",
  "linear-gradient(160deg, #fb923c 0%, #ea580c 100%)",
  "linear-gradient(160deg, #fb7185 0%, #e11d48 100%)",
  "linear-gradient(160deg, #34d399 0%, #059669 100%)"
];

function tileGradient(k, idx = 0) {
  const fixed = {
    games: "linear-gradient(160deg, #38bdf8 0%, #0284c7 100%)",
    chat: "linear-gradient(160deg, #60a5fa 0%, #2563eb 100%)",
    ai: "linear-gradient(160deg, #e879f9 0%, #8b5cf6 52%, #3b82f6 100%)",
    paint: "linear-gradient(160deg, #fb7185 0%, #e11d48 100%)",
    calculator: "linear-gradient(160deg, #fb923c 0%, #ea580c 100%)",
    notes: "linear-gradient(160deg, #facc15 0%, #eab308 100%)",
    weather: "linear-gradient(160deg, #38bdf8 0%, #0369a1 100%)",
    music: "linear-gradient(160deg, #f43f5e 0%, #be123c 100%)",
    terminal: "linear-gradient(160deg, #334155 0%, #0f172a 100%)",
    clock: "linear-gradient(160deg, #1e293b 0%, #090d16 100%)"
  };
  return fixed[k] || APP_TILE_GRADIENTS[idx % APP_TILE_GRADIENTS.length];
}

function renderStartMenu(filter = "") {
  const q = filter.trim().toLowerCase();
  const userApps = [...apps.values()].filter(a => a.key !== "home" && a.key !== "index");
  const items = [
    ...userApps.map((a, i) => ({
      name: a.name, icon: a.icon, color: tileGradient(a.key, i),
      fn: () => { toggleStartMenu(false); openApp(a.key, false); }
    })),
    { name: "Settings", icon: "settings", color: "linear-gradient(160deg, #94a3b8 0%, #64748b 100%)", fn: () => { toggleStartMenu(false); openSettings("preferences"); } },
    { name: "Wallpaper", icon: "image", color: "linear-gradient(160deg, #f43f5e 0%, #be123c 100%)", fn: () => { toggleStartMenu(false); $("wp").showModal(); } },
    { name: "About Blank", icon: "fa-solid fa-ghost", color: "linear-gradient(160deg, #a78bfa 0%, #7c3aed 100%)", fn: () => { toggleStartMenu(false); launchAboutBlank(); } },
    { name: "Blob Mode", icon: "fa-solid fa-shield-halved", color: "linear-gradient(160deg, #34d399 0%, #059669 100%)", fn: () => { toggleStartMenu(false); launchBlob(); } },
    { name: "Discord", icon: "discord", color: "linear-gradient(160deg, #6b76ff 0%, #5865f2 100%)", fn: () => { toggleStartMenu(false); window.open(LINKS.discord, "_blank", "noopener"); } }
  ].filter(item => !q || item.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));

  $("lpGrid").replaceChildren(...items.map(item => {
    const b = h("button", { type: "button", className: "lp-item", onclick: item.fn });
    b.style.setProperty("--c", item.color);
    b.innerHTML = `<div class="lp-ico">${ico(item.icon)}</div><span>${item.name}</span>`;
    return b;
  }));
}

$("smSearch").oninput = e => renderStartMenu(e.target.value);
startMenu.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
  if (e.target === startMenu || e.target.classList.contains("lp-inner") || e.target.classList.contains("lp-grid")) {
    toggleStartMenu(false);
  }
});
expose.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
  if (e.target === expose || e.target === $("exGrid")) {
    toggleExpose(false);
  }
});

/* ===== SPOTLIGHT ===== */
function toggleSpotlight(force) {
  const isOpen = spotlight.classList.contains("open");
  const show = typeof force === "boolean" ? force : !isOpen;
  if (show) {
    menu.hidden = true;
    $("helpMenu").hidden = true;
    toggleStartMenu(false);
    toggleExpose(false);
    $("spInput").value = "";
    spIndex = 0;
    renderSpotlight("");
    spotlight.classList.add("open");
    setTimeout(() => $("spInput").focus(), 30);
  } else {
    spotlight.classList.remove("open");
  }
}

function renderSpotlight(rawQuery = "") {
  const q = rawQuery.trim();
  const ql = q.toLowerCase();
  if (!q) {
    spItems = [];
    $("spResults").replaceChildren();
    return;
  }

  const userApps = [...apps.values()].filter(a => a.key !== "home" && a.key !== "index");
  const catalog = [
    ...userApps.map((a, i) => ({
      name: a.name,
      cat: "Application",
      icon: a.icon,
      color: tileGradient(a.key, i),
      fn: () => { toggleSpotlight(false); openApp(a.key, false); }
    })),
    { name: "Settings", cat: "Application", icon: "settings", color: "linear-gradient(160deg, #94a3b8 0%, #64748b 100%)", fn: () => { toggleSpotlight(false); openSettings("preferences"); } },
    { name: "Wallpaper", cat: "System", icon: "image", color: "linear-gradient(160deg, #f43f5e 0%, #be123c 100%)", fn: () => { toggleSpotlight(false); $("wp").showModal(); } },
    { name: "Mission Control", cat: "System", icon: "fa-solid fa-window-restore", color: "linear-gradient(160deg, #38bdf8 0%, #0284c7 100%)", fn: () => { toggleSpotlight(false); toggleExpose(true); } },
    { name: "About Blank", cat: "System", icon: "fa-solid fa-ghost", color: "linear-gradient(160deg, #a78bfa 0%, #7c3aed 100%)", fn: () => { toggleSpotlight(false); launchAboutBlank(); } },
    { name: "Blob Mode", cat: "System", icon: "fa-solid fa-shield-halved", color: "linear-gradient(160deg, #34d399 0%, #059669 100%)", fn: () => { toggleSpotlight(false); launchBlob(); } },
    { name: "Discord", cat: "Application", icon: "discord", color: "linear-gradient(160deg, #6b76ff 0%, #5865f2 100%)", fn: () => { toggleSpotlight(false); window.open(LINKS.discord, "_blank", "noopener"); } }
  ];

  const matched = catalog
    .filter(item => item.name.toLowerCase().includes(ql))
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const aStarts = a.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(ql) ? 0 : 1;
      const bStarts = b.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(ql) ? 0 : 1;
      return aStarts - bStarts;
    });

  spItems = [
    ...matched,
    {
      name: `Search the web for “${q}”`,
      cat: "Safari",
      isSafari: true,
      fn: () => {
        toggleSpotlight(false);
        window.open("https://www.google.com/search?q=" + encodeURIComponent(q), "_blank", "noopener");
      }
    }
  ];

  if (spIndex >= spItems.length) spIndex = 0;

  $("spResults").replaceChildren(...spItems.map((item, idx) => {
    const row = h("button", {
      type: "button",
      className: "sp-row" + (idx === spIndex ? " active" : ""),
      onclick: item.fn,
      onmouseenter: () => {
        if (spIndex !== idx) {
          spIndex = idx;
          $("spResults").querySelectorAll(".sp-row").forEach((r, i) => r.classList.toggle("active", i === spIndex));
        }
      }
    });

    const icoEl = h("span", { className: "sp-ico" + (item.isSafari ? " safari" : "") });
    if (item.isSafari) {
      icoEl.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" fill="#2563eb"/><polygon points="15.5,8.5 13.2,13.2 8.5,15.5 10.8,10.8" fill="#ef4444"/><polygon points="15.5,8.5 13.2,13.2 10.8,10.8" fill="#ffffff"/></svg>`;
    } else {
      icoEl.style.setProperty("--sp-c", item.color);
      icoEl.innerHTML = ico(item.icon);
    }

    row.append(
      icoEl,
      h("span", { className: "sp-name", textContent: item.name }),
      h("span", { className: "sp-cat", textContent: item.cat })
    );
    return row;
  }));
}

$("spInput").addEventListener("input", e => {
  spIndex = 0;
  renderSpotlight(e.target.value);
});
$("spInput").addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  if (!spItems.length) return;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
    e.preventDefault();
    spIndex = (spIndex + 1) % spItems.length;
    $("spResults").querySelectorAll(".sp-row").forEach((r, i) => r.classList.toggle("active", i === spIndex));
  } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
    e.preventDefault();
    spIndex = (spIndex - 1 + spItems.length) % spItems.length;
    $("spResults").querySelectorAll(".sp-row").forEach((r, i) => r.classList.toggle("active", i === spIndex));
  } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (spItems[spIndex]) spItems[spIndex].fn();
  }
});
spotlight.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
  if (e.target === spotlight) toggleSpotlight(false);
});

/* ===== SETTINGS ===== */
function openSettings(initialTab = "preferences") {
  if (wins.has("settings-win")) {
    const existing = wins.get("settings-win");
    focusWin(existing);
    existing.el.querySelector('.st-nav[data-tab="' + initialTab + '"]')?.click();
    return;
  }

  const el = h("section", { className: "win" });
  el.setAttribute("aria-label", "Settings");
  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="tb">
      <div class="wb">
        <button type="button" class="b-c" aria-label="Close"></button>
        <button type="button" class="b-m" aria-label="Minimize"></button>
        <button type="button" class="b-x" aria-label="Maximize"></button>
      </div>
      <span class="tt"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-gear"></i><b>Settings</b></span>
      <span></span>
    </div>
    <div class="wbody">
      <div class="st-shell">
        <aside class="st-side">
          <button type="button" class="st-nav active" data-tab="preferences"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-sliders"></i>Preferences</button>
          <button type="button" class="st-nav" data-tab="account"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-user-circle"></i>Account</button>
          <button type="button" class="st-nav" data-tab="display"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-sun"></i>Display</button>
          <button type="button" class="st-nav" data-tab="sound"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-volume-high"></i>Sound</button>
          <button type="button" class="st-nav" data-tab="network"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-wifi"></i>Network</button>
          <button type="button" class="st-nav" data-tab="notifications"><i class="ic fa-regular fa-bell"></i>Notifications</button>
          <button type="button" class="st-nav" data-tab="datetime"><i class="ic fa-regular fa-clock"></i>Date & Time</button>
          <button type="button" class="st-nav" data-tab="access"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-universal-access"></i>Accessibility</button>
          <button type="button" class="st-nav" data-tab="cloaking"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-user-secret"></i>Tab Cloaker</button>
          <button type="button" class="st-nav" data-tab="themes"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-palette"></i>Themes</button>
          <button type="button" class="st-nav" data-tab="background"><i class="ic fa-regular fa-image"></i>Background</button>
          <button type="button" class="st-nav" data-tab="data"><i class="ic fa-solid fa-database"></i>Data</button>
        </aside>
        <div class="st-main" id="stMain"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <i class="rs"></i>
  `;
  const W = Math.min(760, Math.round(innerWidth * 0.86)), H = Math.min(540, Math.round(innerHeight * 0.8));
  Object.assign(el.style, { width: W + "px", height: H + "px", left: Math.max(12, Math.round((innerWidth - W) / 2)) + "px", top: Math.max(44, Math.round((innerHeight - H) / 2)) + "px" });
  const main = el.querySelector("#stMain");

  function renderTab(tab) {
    el.querySelectorAll(".st-nav").forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.tab === tab));
    if (tab === "preferences") {
      main.innerHTML = `
        <h2 class="st-heading">Preferences</h2>
        <p class="st-sub">Stealth launch modes, desktop widgets, and quick disguises.</p>
        <div class="st-grid-2">
          <div class="st-card">
            <h3><i class="fa-solid fa-ghost" style="color:var(--acc)"></i> About Blank</h3>
            <p>Opens the OS inside an invisible <code>about:blank</code> frame.</p>
            <div class="st-btn-row"><button type="button" class="ib primary" id="st-ab">Launch</button></div>
          </div>
          <div class="st-card">
            <h3><i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved" style="color:var(--acc2)"></i> Blob</h3>
            <p>Creates a temporary encrypted <code>blob:</code> session URL.</p>
            <div class="st-btn-row"><button type="button" class="ib primary" id="st-blob">Launch</button></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="st-card">
          <h3><i class="fa-solid fa-compass" style="color:#38bdf8"></i> Desktop Quick Guide</h3>
          <p>Replay the interactive 4-step walkthrough anytime.</p>
          <div class="st-btn-row"><button type="button" class="ib primary" id="st-replay-guide"><i class="fa-solid fa-sparkles"></i> Open Guide</button></div>
        </div>
        <div class="st-card">
          <h3><i class="fa-solid fa-calendar-day" style="color:#38bdf8"></i> Desktop Clock & Date</h3>
          <p>Toggle the large center date display on your wallpaper.</p>
          <div class="st-btn-row"><button type="button" class="ib" id="st-toggle-date">${ls.get("sh0zy.hidedate") === "1" ? "Show Date Hero" : "Hide Date Hero"}</button></div>
        </div>
        <div class="st-card">
          <h3><i class="fa-solid fa-masks-theater" style="color:#f59e0b"></i> Tab Presets</h3>
          <p>Instantly disguise your browser tab title and icon.</p>
          <div class="st-presets" id="stPresets"></div>
        </div>
      `;
      main.querySelector("#st-ab").onclick = launchAboutBlank;
      main.querySelector("#st-blob").onclick = launchBlob;
      main.querySelector("#st-replay-guide").onclick = () => openFirstRunGuide(0);
      main.querySelector("#st-toggle-date").onclick = () => {
        const next = ls.get("sh0zy.hidedate") === "1" ? "0" : "1";
        ls.set("sh0zy.hidedate", next);
        applySettings();
        renderTab("preferences");
      };
      const pBox = main.querySelector("#stPresets");
      TAB_PRESETS.forEach(p => {
        const btn = h("button", { type: "button", className: "st-preset-chip" });
        btn.innerHTML = `<img src="${p.icon}" alt="" onerror="this.style.display='none'"><span>${p.name}</span>`;
        btn.onclick = () => { ls.set("sh0zy.title", p.title); ls.set("sh0zy.icon", p.icon); applySettings(); notify(`Tab disguised as ${p.name}`); };
        pBox.append(btn);
      });
    } else if (tab === "account") {
      let accObj = { name: "User", hint: "" };
      try { accObj = JSON.parse(ls.get("sift.account") || '{"name":"User","hint":""}'); } catch {}
      main.innerHTML = `
        <h2 class="st-heading">Computer Account</h2>
        <p class="st-sub">Manage your local browser user profile or re-run the Setup Assistant.</p>
        <div class="st-card">
          <h3><i class="fa-solid fa-id-card" style="color:var(--acc)"></i> Signed in as ${accObj.name || "User"}</h3>
          <p>${accObj.hint ? "Password hint: " + accObj.hint : "Local browser account configured."}</p>
          <div class="st-btn-row">
            <button type="button" class="ib primary" id="st-rerun-setup"><i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles"></i> Re-run Hello Setup</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="st-card">
          <h3><i class="fa-solid fa-signature" style="color:var(--acc2)"></i> Display name</h3>
          <p>This is the name shown in the menu bar and on the lock screen.</p>
          <div class="st-field" style="margin-top:0"><label for="st-name">Name</label><input id="st-name" maxlength="24"></div>
          <div class="st-btn-row" style="margin-top:14px"><button type="button" class="ib primary" id="st-name-save">Save name</button></div>
        </div>
      `;
      main.querySelector("#st-name").value = accObj.name || "User";
      main.querySelector("#st-name-save").onclick = () => {
        accObj.name = main.querySelector("#st-name").value.trim() || "User";
        ls.set("sift.account", JSON.stringify(accObj));
        refreshUser(); renderTab("account"); notify("Name updated");
      };
      main.querySelector("#st-rerun-setup").onclick = () => {
        ls.del("sift.setupDone");
        location.reload();
      };
    } else if (tab === "cloaking") {
      main.innerHTML = `
        <h2 class="st-heading">Tab Cloaker</h2>
        <p class="st-sub">Customize your tab's appearance.</p>
        <div class="st-card">
          <div class="st-field"><label>Custom Tab Title</label><input id="st-c-title" value="${ls.get("sh0zy.title") || "SIFT"}"></div>
          <div class="st-field"><label>Custom Favicon URL</label><input id="st-c-icon" value="${ls.get("sh0zy.icon")}"></div>
          <div class="st-btn-row" style="margin-top:14px"><button type="button" class="ib primary" id="st-c-save">Apply</button></div>
        </div>
      `;
      main.querySelector("#st-c-save").onclick = () => {
        ls.set("sh0zy.title", main.querySelector("#st-c-title").value.trim());
        ls.set("sh0zy.icon", main.querySelector("#st-c-icon").value.trim());
        applySettings(); notify("Tab identity updated!");
      };
    } else if (tab === "themes") {
      const cur = ls.get("sh0zy.theme") || "glass";
      main.innerHTML = `
        <h2 class="st-heading">Themes & Accent</h2>
        <p class="st-sub">Switch visual theme and system accent highlight.</p>
        <div class="theme-cards">
          <button type="button" class="theme-card ${cur==="glass"?"selected":""}" data-th="glass"><div class="theme-swatch" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e293b,#6a95ff)"></div><b>macOS Glass</b></button>
          <button type="button" class="theme-card ${cur==="obsidian"?"selected":""}" data-th="obsidian"><div class="theme-swatch" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#090a0f,#1e293b)"></div><b>Obsidian</b></button>
          <button type="button" class="theme-card ${cur==="crystal"?"selected":""}" data-th="crystal"><div class="theme-swatch" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f8fafc,#cbd5e1)"></div><b>Crystal Light</b></button>
        </div>
        <div class="st-card">
          <h3><i class="fa-solid fa-droplet" style="color:var(--acc)"></i> Accent Color</h3>
          <p>Pick an accent tint for buttons, indicators, and highlights.</p>
          <div class="st-btn-row" id="stAccRow"></div>
        </div>
      `;
      main.querySelectorAll(".theme-card").forEach(btn => {
        btn.onclick = () => {
          ls.set("sh0zy.theme", btn.dataset.th);
          applySettings();
          renderTab("themes");
        };
      });
      const accColors = ["#2b7fff", "#9333ea", "#e11d48", "#ea580c", "#16a34a", "#64748b"];
      accColors.forEach(c => {
        const dot = h("button", {
          type: "button",
          className: "accent-dot" + ((ls.get("sh0zy.acc") || "#2b7fff") === c ? " selected" : ""),
          onclick: () => { ls.set("sh0zy.acc", c); applySettings(); renderTab("themes"); }
        });
        dot.style.background = c;
        dot.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>';
        main.querySelector("#stAccRow").append(dot);
      });
    } else if (tab === "background") {
      main.innerHTML = `
        <h2 class="st-heading">Wallpaper</h2>
        <p class="st-sub">Choose a preset wallpaper or open the custom uploader.</p>
        <div class="wp-grid" id="stWpGrid"></div>
        <div class="st-btn-row" style="margin-top:14px">
          <button type="button" class="ib primary" id="stOpenWp"><i class="fa-solid fa-upload"></i> Custom Image / Link</button>
        </div>
      `;
      main.querySelector("#stOpenWp").onclick = () => $("wp").showModal();
      const wg = main.querySelector("#stWpGrid");
      PRESET_WALLPAPERS.forEach(w => {
        const item = h("button", { type: "button", className: "wp-item" });
        item.style.backgroundImage = `url("${w.url}")`;
        item.innerHTML = `<span>${w.name}</span>`;
        item.onclick = () => { ls.set("sh0zy.bg", w.url); applySettings(); notify(`Wallpaper set to ${w.name}`); };
        wg.append(item);
      });
    } else if (SYS_TABS[tab]) {
      SYS_TABS[tab](main);
    } else if (tab === "data") {
      main.innerHTML = `
        <h2 class="st-heading">Data</h2>
        <p class="st-sub">Clear cached pages, notes, and local settings.</p>
        <div class="st-card">
          <div class="st-btn-row">
            <button type="button" class="ib" id="stClearCache"><i class="fa-solid fa-broom"></i> Clear App Cache</button>
            <button type="button" class="ib" id="stResetAll"><i class="fa-solid fa-rotate-left"></i> Factory Reset OS</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
      main.querySelector("#stClearCache").onclick = () => { cache.clear(); notify("Page cache cleared!"); };
      main.querySelector("#stResetAll").onclick = () => { localStorage.clear(); location.reload(); };
    }
  }

  el.querySelectorAll(".st-nav").forEach(btn => btn.onclick = () => renderTab(btn.dataset.tab));
  renderTab(initialTab);

  const wObj = { app: { key: "settings-win", name: "Settings" }, el, min: false };
  attachWindowControls(el, wObj);
  desk.append(el); wins.set("settings-win", wObj); focusWin(wObj);
}

/* ===== NATIVE APPS ===== */
function attachWindowControls(el, wObj) {
  const tb = el.querySelector(".tb"), rs = el.querySelector(".rs");
  el.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => focusWin(wObj), true);
  tb.addEventListener("dblclick", e => { if (!e.target.closest("button")) toggleMax(wObj); });
  el.querySelector(".b-m").onclick = () => minimize(wObj);
  el.querySelector(".b-x").onclick = () => toggleMax(wObj);
  el.querySelector(".b-c").onclick = () => closeWin(wObj);

  const drag = (handle, start, move) => handle.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
    if (e.button || e.target.closest("button") || el.classList.contains("max")) return;
    const s = start(e); handle.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); desk.classList.add("drag");
    const mv = ev => move(ev, s), up = () => { handle.removeEventListener("pointermove", mv); handle.removeEventListener("pointerup", up); desk.classList.remove("drag"); };
    handle.addEventListener("pointermove", mv); handle.addEventListener("pointerup", up);
  });
  drag(tb, e => ({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, l: el.offsetLeft, t: el.offsetTop }), (e, s) => {
    el.style.left = Math.min(innerWidth - 80, Math.max(80 - el.offsetWidth, s.l + e.clientX - s.x)) + "px";
    el.style.top = Math.min(innerHeight - 60, Math.max(32, s.t + e.clientY - s.y)) + "px";
  });
  if (rs) {
    drag(rs, e => ({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, w: el.offsetWidth, h: el.offsetHeight }), (e, s) => {
      el.style.width = Math.max(320, s.w + e.clientX - s.x) + "px";
      el.style.height = Math.max(260, s.h + e.clientY - s.y) + "px";
    });
  }
}

          <button type="button" class="calc-btn" data-k="3">3</button>
          <button type="button" class="calc-btn op" data-k="+">+</button>
          <button type="button" class="calc-btn zero" data-k="0">0</button>
          <button type="button" class="calc-btn" data-k=".">.</button>
          <button type="button" class="calc-btn op" data-k="=">=</button>

      </div>
    </div>
    <i class="rs"></i>
  `;
  const W = 320, H = 460;
  Object.assign(el.style, { width: W + "px", height: H + "px", left: Math.max(12, Math.round((innerWidth - W) / 2) + n * 24) + "px", top: Math.max(44, 70 + n * 24) + "px" });

  let cur = "0", prev = null, op = null, fresh = false;
  const valEl = el.querySelector("#cVal"), exprEl = el.querySelector("#cExpr");
  const render = () => {
    valEl.textContent = cur;
    exprEl.textContent = prev !== null && op ? `${prev} ${op}` : "";
  };
  const compute = (a, b, operator) => {
    if (operator === "+") return a + b;
    if (operator === "-") return a - b;
    if (operator === "*") return a * b;
    if (operator === "/") return b === 0 ? "Error" : a / b;
    return b;
  };

  el.querySelectorAll(".calc-btn").forEach(btn => {
    btn.onclick = () => {
      const k = btn.dataset.k;
      if (/^[0-9]$/.test(k)) {
        cur = (cur === "0" || cur === "Error" || fresh) ? k : cur + k;
        fresh = false;
      } else if (k === ".") {
        if (fresh || cur === "Error") { cur = "0."; fresh = false; }
        else if (!cur.includes(".")) cur += ".";
      } else if (k === "AC") {
        cur = "0"; prev = null; op = null; fresh = false;
      } else if (k === "NEG") {
        if (cur !== "0" && cur !== "Error") cur = String(parseFloat(cur) * -1);
      } else if (k === "PCT") {
        if (cur !== "Error") cur = String(parseFloat(cur) / 100);
      } else if (["+", "-", "*", "/"].includes(k)) {
        if (prev !== null && op && !fresh) {
          const res = compute(parseFloat(prev), parseFloat(cur), op);
          cur = res === "Error" ? "Error" : String(Number(res.toFixed(8)));
        }
        prev = cur; op = k; fresh = true;
      } else if (k === "=" && prev !== null && op) {
        const res = compute(parseFloat(prev), parseFloat(cur), op);
        cur = res === "Error" ? "Error" : String(Number(res.toFixed(8)));
        prev = null; op = null; fresh = true;
      }
      render();
    };
  });

  const wObj = { app, el, min: false };
  attachWindowControls(el, wObj);
  desk.append(el); wins.set(app.key, wObj); focusWin(wObj);
}

function openNotes(app) {
  const el = h("section", { className: "win" }), n = wins.size;
  el.setAttribute("aria-label", app.name);
  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="tb">
      <div class="wb">
        <button type="button" class="b-c" aria-label="Close"></button>
        <button type="button" class="b-m" aria-label="Minimize"></button>
        <button type="button" class="b-x" aria-label="Maximize"></button>
      </div>
      <span class="tt">${ico(app.icon)}<b>Notes</b></span>
      <span></span>
    </div>
    <div class="wbody">
      <div class="notes-app">
        <aside class="notes-side">
          <div style="display:flex;gap:6px">
            <button type="button" class="ib primary" id="nAdd" style="flex:1;height:30px;font-size:12px"><i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i> New</button>
            <button type="button" class="ib" id="nDel" style="height:30px;padding:0 10px" title="Delete Note"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i></button>
          </div>
          <div class="notes-list" id="nList"></div>
        </aside>
        <div class="notes-editor">
          <input class="notes-title-in" id="nTitle" placeholder="Note Title">
          <textarea class="notes-body-in" id="nBody" placeholder="Start typing your note..."></textarea>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <i class="rs"></i>
  `;
  const W = Math.min(720, Math.round(innerWidth * 0.82)), H = Math.min(480, Math.round(innerHeight * 0.72));
  Object.assign(el.style, { width: W + "px", height: H + "px", left: Math.max(12, Math.round((innerWidth - W) / 2) + n * 24) + "px", top: Math.max(44, 62 + n * 24) + "px" });

  let notes = [];
  try { notes = JSON.parse(ls.get("sh0zy.notes") || "[]"); } catch {}
  if (!notes.length) {
    notes = [{ id: Date.now(), title: "Welcome to SIFT Notes", body: "Jot down quick ideas, homework reminders, or links here. Everything saves automatically in your browser!" }];
  }
  let activeId = notes[0].id;
  const saveNotes = () => ls.set("sh0zy.notes", JSON.stringify(notes));

  const listEl = el.querySelector("#nList"), titleIn = el.querySelector("#nTitle"), bodyIn = el.querySelector("#nBody");
  function renderNotes() {
    const activeNote = notes.find(x => x.id === activeId) || notes[0];
    if (activeNote) {
      activeId = activeNote.id;
      titleIn.value = activeNote.title;
      bodyIn.value = activeNote.body;
    }
    listEl.replaceChildren(...notes.map(item => {
      const btn = h("button", {
        type: "button",
        className: "note-item" + (item.id === activeId ? " active" : ""),
        onclick: () => { activeId = item.id; renderNotes(); }
      });
      btn.append(
        h("b", { textContent: item.title || "Untitled Note" }),
        h("small", { textContent: item.body || "No additional text" })
      );
      return btn;
    }));
  }

  titleIn.oninput = () => {
    const cur = notes.find(x => x.id === activeId);
    if (cur) { cur.title = titleIn.value; saveNotes(); renderNotes(); }
  };
  bodyIn.oninput = () => {
    const cur = notes.find(x => x.id === activeId);
    if (cur) { cur.body = bodyIn.value; saveNotes(); renderNotes(); }
  };
  el.querySelector("#nAdd").onclick = () => {
    const freshNote = { id: Date.now(), title: "New Note", body: "" };
    notes.unshift(freshNote);
    activeId = freshNote.id;
    saveNotes();
    renderNotes();
    titleIn.focus();
  };
  el.querySelector("#nDel").onclick = () => {
    if (notes.length <= 1) {
      notes[0].title = "New Note"; notes[0].body = "";
    } else {
      notes = notes.filter(x => x.id !== activeId);
      activeId = notes[0].id;
    }
    saveNotes();
    renderNotes();
  };
  renderNotes();

  const wObj = { app, el, min: false };
  attachWindowControls(el, wObj);
  desk.append(el); wins.set(app.key, wObj); focusWin(wObj);
}

function openPaint(app) {
  const el = h("section", { className: "win" }), n = wins.size;
  el.setAttribute("aria-label", app.name);
  const colors = ["#111827", "#ef4444", "#f97316", "#eab308", "#22c55e", "#3b82f6", "#a855f7", "#ffffff"];
  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="tb">
      <div class="wb">
        <button type="button" class="b-c" aria-label="Close"></button>
        <button type="button" class="b-m" aria-label="Minimize"></button>
        <button type="button" class="b-x" aria-label="Maximize"></button>
      </div>
      <span class="tt">${ico(app.icon)}<b>Paint</b></span>
      <span></span>
    </div>
    <div class="wbody">
      <div class="paint-app">
        <div class="paint-bar">
          <div id="pSwatches" style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center"></div>
          <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);margin-left:8px">
            Size <input id="pSize" type="range" min="2" max="36" value="5" style="width:84px">
          </label>
          <div style="margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:6px">
            <button type="button" class="ib" id="pClear" style="height:28px;padding:0 10px;font-size:12px">Clear</button>
            <button type="button" class="ib primary" id="pSave" style="height:28px;padding:0 10px;font-size:12px">Save PNG</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="paint-canvas-wrap" id="pWrap">
          <canvas id="pCanvas"></canvas>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <i class="rs"></i>
  `;
  const W = Math.min(780, Math.round(innerWidth * 0.84)), H = Math.min(520, Math.round(innerHeight * 0.76));
  Object.assign(el.style, { width: W + "px", height: H + "px", left: Math.max(12, Math.round((innerWidth - W) / 2) + n * 24) + "px", top: Math.max(44, 58 + n * 24) + "px" });

  let brushColor = "#111827", brushSize = 5, drawing = false;
  const swBox = el.querySelector("#pSwatches");
  colors.forEach((c, idx) => {
    const sw = h("button", {
      type: "button",
      className: "paint-swatch" + (idx === 0 ? " active" : ""),
      title: c === "#ffffff" ? "Eraser" : c,
      onclick: () => {
        brushColor = c;
        swBox.querySelectorAll(".paint-swatch").forEach(s => s.classList.remove("active"));
        sw.classList.add("active");
      }
    });
    sw.style.background = c;
    swBox.append(sw);
  });

  el.querySelector("#pSize").oninput = e => { brushSize = Number(e.target.value); };

  const wrap = el.querySelector("#pWrap"), canvas = el.querySelector("#pCanvas"), ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const resizeCanvas = () => {
    const prevImg = canvas.width && canvas.height ? ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height) : null;
    canvas.width = wrap.clientWidth || 740;
    canvas.height = wrap.clientHeight || 420;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    if (prevImg) ctx.putImageData(prevImg, 0, 0);
  };

  const getPos = e => {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
  };
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
    drawing = true;
    canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    const p = getPos(e);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.lineJoin = "round";
    ctx.strokeStyle = brushColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = brushSize;
    ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
    if (!drawing) return;
    const p = getPos(e);
    ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  });
  const endDraw = () => { drawing = false; };
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", endDraw);
  canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", endDraw);

  el.querySelector("#pClear").onclick = () => {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  };
  el.querySelector("#pSave").onclick = () => {
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.download = "sift-drawing.png";
    a.href = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
    a.click();
    notify("Saved drawing as PNG!");
  };

  const wObj = { app, el, min: false };
  attachWindowControls(el, wObj);
  desk.append(el); wins.set(app.key, wObj); focusWin(wObj);
  requestAnimationFrame(resizeCanvas);
}

  const el = h("section", { className: "win" }), n = wins.size;
  el.setAttribute("aria-label", app.name);
  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="tb">

      <span></span>
    </div>
    <div class="wbody">
      <div class="term-app">
        <div class="term-output" id="tOut">
          <div>SIFT Darwin Kernel v15.1 — Type <b>help</b> for commands.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="term-input-row">
          <span>sift@macbook ~ %</span>
          <input id="tIn" type="text" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <i class="rs"></i>
  `;
  const out = el.querySelector("#tOut"), inp = el.querySelector("#tIn");
  const print = txt => { out.append(h("div", { textContent: txt })); out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight; };
  inp.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    if (e.key !== "Enter") return;
    const cmd = inp.value.trim();
    inp.value = "";
    if (!cmd) return;
    print(`sift@macbook ~ % ${cmd}`);
    if (cmd === "help") print("Available commands: help, whoami, date, clear, apps, setup");
    else if (cmd === "whoami") {
      let nm = "user";
      try { nm = JSON.parse(ls.get("sift.account") || "{}").name || "user"; } catch {}
      print(nm);
    } else if (cmd === "date") print(new Date().toString());
    else if (cmd === "apps") print([...apps.keys()].join(", "));
    else if (cmd === "setup") { ls.del("sift.setupDone"); location.reload(); }
    else if (cmd === "clear") out.replaceChildren();
    else print(`zsh: command not found: ${cmd}`);
  });

  const W = 580, H = 380;
  Object.assign(el.style, { width: W + "px", height: H + "px", left: Math.max(12, Math.round((innerWidth - W) / 2) + n * 24) + "px", top: Math.max(44, 64 + n * 24) + "px" });
  const wObj = { app, el, min: false };
  attachWindowControls(el, wObj);
  desk.append(el); wins.set(app.key, wObj); focusWin(wObj);
  setTimeout(() => inp.focus(), 40);
}

/* ===== WINDOW MANAGER ===== */
const topWin = () => [...wins.values()].filter(x => !x.min).sort((a, b) => a.el.style.zIndex - b.el.style.zIndex).pop() || null;
function paintDock() {
  dockBtns.forEach((b, k) => {
    b.classList.toggle("open", wins.has(k));
    b.classList.toggle("act", !!focused && focused.app.key === k);
  });
  if ($("topActiveApp")) {
    $("topActiveApp").textContent = focused && !focused.min ? focused.app.name : "Finder";
  }
}
function focusWin(w) {
  if (w.min) { w.min = false; w.el.classList.remove("min"); }
  w.el.style.zIndex = ++zTop; focused = w; wins.forEach(x => x.el.classList.toggle("focus", x === w)); paintDock();
  syncFullscreenState();
}
function minimize(w) {
  w.min = true;
  w.el.classList.add("min");
  w.el.classList.remove("focus");
  if (focused === w) focused = topWin();
  if (focused) focused.el.classList.add("focus");
  paintDock();
  syncFullscreenState();
}
function closeWin(w) {
  w.el.remove();
  wins.delete(w.app.key);
  if (focused === w) focused = topWin();
  if (focused) focused.el.classList.add("focus");
  paintDock();
  syncFullscreenState();
}
const toggleMax = w => {
  w.el.classList.toggle("max");
  syncFullscreenState();
};

function createWin(app) {
  const el = h("section", { className: "win" }), n = wins.size;
  el.setAttribute("aria-label", app.name);
  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="tb">
      <div class="wb">
        <button type="button" class="b-c" aria-label="Close"></button>
        <button type="button" class="b-m" aria-label="Minimize"></button>
        <button type="button" class="b-x" aria-label="Maximize"></button>
      </div>
      <span class="tt"></span>
      <span></span>
    </div>
    <div class="wbody"><div class="ph"></div></div>
    <i class="rs"></i>
  `;
  el.querySelector(".tt").innerHTML = ico(app.icon) + "<b>" + app.name + "</b>";
  const W = Math.min(980, Math.round(innerWidth * 0.74)), H = Math.min(640, Math.round(innerHeight * 0.72));
  Object.assign(el.style, { width: W + "px", height: H + "px", left: Math.max(8, Math.round((innerWidth - W) / 2) + n * 24 - 24) + "px", top: Math.max(42, 58 + n * 24) + "px" });
  const frame = h("iframe", { title: app.name });
  frame.setAttribute("sandbox", "allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-popups allow-pointer-lock allow-fullscreen");
  frame.setAttribute("allow", "fullscreen; autoplay; pointer-lock; gamepad; clipboard-write");
  const ph = el.querySelector(".ph"), w = { app, el, frame, min: false };

  w.load = async fresh => {
    ph.hidden = false; ph.replaceChildren(h("div", { className: "spin" }), h("span", { textContent: "Loading " + app.name + "…" }));
    try { const html = await getPage(app.file, fresh); frame.srcdoc = html + FWD; }
    catch { ph.replaceChildren(h("span", { textContent: "Couldn't load " + app.name + "." }), h("button", { className: "ib primary", textContent: "Retry", onclick: () => w.load(true) })); }
  };
  frame.addEventListener("load", () => { if (frame.srcdoc) ph.hidden = true; });
  el.querySelector(".wbody").append(frame);

  attachWindowControls(el, w);
  desk.append(el); wins.set(app.key, w);
  focusWin(w); w.load(); return w;
}

function openApp(key, toggle) {
  const app = apps.get(key); if (!app) return;
  const w = wins.get(key);
  if (!w) {
    if (app.native === "calculator") openCalculator(app);
    else if (app.native === "notes") openNotes(app);
    else if (app.native === "paint") openPaint(app);
    else if (app.native === "weather") openWeather(app);
    else if (app.native === "music") openMusic(app);
    else if (app.native === "terminal") openTerminal(app);
    else if (app.native === "clock") openClockApp(app);
    else createWin(app);
  } else if (w.min || focused !== w || !toggle) focusWin(w);
  else minimize(w);
}

/* ===== DOCK ===== */
function dockBtn(label, icon, tileBg, fn, key, extraClass = "", customSvg = "") {
  const b = h("button", { type: "button", onclick: fn, className: ("dk " + extraClass).trim() });
  b.setAttribute("aria-label", label);
  if (tileBg) b.style.setProperty("--tile-bg", tileBg);
  b.dataset.tip = label;
  b.innerHTML = '<span class="ti">' + (customSvg || ico(icon)) + "</span>";
  if (key) dockBtns.set(key, b);
  return b;
}

function buildDock() {
  const userApps = [...apps.values()].filter(a => a.key !== "home" && a.key !== "index");
  const siftMarkSvg = `<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="24" height="24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" rx="15" transform="rotate(45 50 50)" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="11"/><rect x="38" y="38" width="24" height="24" rx="6" transform="rotate(45 50 50)" fill="currentColor"/></svg>`;
  $("dock").replaceChildren(
    dockBtn("Launchpad", "fa-solid fa-grip", null, e => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleStartMenu(); }, null, "start-dk", siftMarkSvg),
    h("i", { className: "sep" }),
    ...userApps.map((a, i) => dockBtn(a.name, a.icon, tileGradient(a.key, i), () => openApp(a.key, true), a.key, "app-" + a.key)),
    h("i", { className: "sep" }),
    dockBtn("Discord", "discord", "linear-gradient(160deg, #6b76ff 0%, #5865f2 100%)", () => window.open(LINKS.discord, "_blank", "noopener"), null, "app-discord"),
    dockBtn("Settings", "settings", "linear-gradient(160deg, #94a3b8 0%, #64748b 100%)", () => openSettings("preferences"), "settings-win", "app-settings")
  );
}

/* ===== WIDGETS & CLOCK ===== */
$("updList").replaceChildren(...UPDATES.map(u => {
  const a = h("article", { className: "u" });
  a.append(h("small", { textContent: u.date + (u.tag ? " · " + u.tag : "") }), h("b", { textContent: u.title }), h("p", { textContent: u.text }));
  if (u.bullets) a.append(h("ul", {}, ...u.bullets.map(t => h("li", { textContent: t }))));
  return a;
}));
$("updBtn").onclick = () => $("upd").classList.toggle("shut");

/* ===== CONTROL CENTER, SYSTEM STATE & ACCOUNT CHIP ===== */
const SYS_DEF = { wifi: true, bt: true, air: 0, dnd: false, night: false, bright: 100, vol: 60, mute: false, sfx: true, widgets: true, clock24: false, secs: false, rmotion: false, rtrans: false };
const SYS = {};
for (const k in SYS_DEF) {
  const d = SYS_DEF[k], raw = ls.get("sift.sys." + k);
  SYS[k] = raw === "" ? d : typeof d === "boolean" ? raw === "1" : (Number(raw) || 0);
}
const AIR_MODES = ["Contacts Only", "Everyone", "Receiving Off"];
const MEDIA = {
  tracks: [
    { title: "Midnight Horizon", artist: "SIFT Synthwave" },
    { title: "Sequoia Breeze", artist: "Ambient Chill" },
    { title: "Glass Reflections", artist: "Lo-Fi Study Beats" }
  ],
  idx: 0, playing: false, subs: new Set(),
  emit() { this.subs.forEach(f => f()); },
  toggle() { this.playing = !this.playing; this.emit(); },
  next() { this.idx = (this.idx + 1) % this.tracks.length; this.emit(); },
  prev() { this.idx = (this.idx - 1 + this.tracks.length) % this.tracks.length; this.emit(); }
};
const setOn = (id, on) => { const e = $(id); e.classList.toggle("on", on); e.setAttribute("aria-pressed", on); };
const setF = r => r.style.setProperty("--f", (r.value - r.min) / (r.max - r.min));
const volIco = () => SYS.mute || !SYS.vol ? "fa-volume-xmark" : SYS.vol < 40 ? "fa-volume-low" : "fa-volume-high";

function sysSet(k, v) {
  SYS[k] = v;
  ls.set("sift.sys." + k, typeof v === "boolean" ? (v ? "1" : "0") : String(v));
  applySystem();
}
function applySystem() {
  document.body.classList.toggle("reduce-motion", SYS.rmotion);
  document.body.classList.toggle("reduce-trans", SYS.rtrans);
  $("dim").style.opacity = ((100 - SYS.bright) / 100 * 0.8).toFixed(3);
  $("warm").style.opacity = SYS.night ? "1" : "0";
  $("widgets").hidden = !SYS.widgets;
  $("topWifiBtn").style.opacity = SYS.wifi ? "" : ".38";
  $("topWifiBtn").title = SYS.wifi ? "Connected to SIFT Network" : "Wi-Fi Off";
  $("topDnd").hidden = !SYS.dnd;
  setOn("ccWifi", SYS.wifi); $("ccWifiSub").textContent = SYS.wifi ? "SIFT Network" : "Off";
  setOn("ccBt", SYS.bt); $("ccBtSub").textContent = SYS.bt ? "On" : "Off";
  setOn("ccAir", SYS.air !== 2); $("ccAirSub").textContent = AIR_MODES[SYS.air] || AIR_MODES[0];
  setOn("ccDnd", SYS.dnd); setOn("ccNight", SYS.night); setOn("ccMute", SYS.mute);
  $("ccBright").value = SYS.bright; $("ccVol").value = SYS.vol;
  setF($("ccBright")); setF($("ccVol"));
  $("ccVolIco").className = "fa-solid " + volIco();
  tick();
}

let actx = null;
function blip() {
  if (SYS.mute || !SYS.sfx || !SYS.vol) return;
  try {
    actx = actx || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const o = actx.createOscillator(), g = actx.createGain();
    o.frequency.value = 660; g.gain.value = SYS.vol / 100 * 0.25;
    o.connect(g); g.connect(actx.destination);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, actx.currentTime + 0.14);
    o.start(); o.stop(actx.currentTime + 0.15);
  } catch {}
}

/* Control Center panel */
const cc = $("cc"), umenu = $("userMenu");
function toggleCC(force) {
  const open = force ?? !cc.classList.contains("open");
  if (open) { menu.hidden = true; umenu.hidden = true; $("helpMenu").hidden = true; toggleStartMenu(false); toggleExpose(false); toggleSpotlight(false); }
  cc.classList.toggle("open", open);
}
$("topCcBtn").onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleCC(); };
$("ccWifi").onclick = () => sysSet("wifi", !SYS.wifi);
$("ccBt").onclick = () => sysSet("bt", !SYS.bt);
$("ccAir").onclick = () => sysSet("air", (SYS.air + 1) % 3);
$("ccDnd").onclick = () => sysSet("dnd", !SYS.dnd);
$("ccNight").onclick = () => sysSet("night", !SYS.night);
$("ccFull").onclick = () => {
  toggleCC(false);
  const isActive = document.body.classList.contains("in-fullscreen") || !!document.fullscreenElement;
  if (isActive) {
    fullscreenButtonMode = false;
    document.body.classList.remove("in-fullscreen");
    if (document.fullscreenElement) document.exitFullscreen?.();
  } else {
    fullscreenButtonMode = true;
    document.body.classList.add("in-fullscreen");
    const request = document.documentElement.requestFullscreen || document.documentElement.webkitRequestFullscreen;
    if (request) {
      try {
        const result = request.call(document.documentElement);
        if (result && result.catch) result.catch(() => syncFullscreenState());
      } catch { syncFullscreenState(); }
    }
    syncFullscreenState();
  }
};
$("ccBright").oninput = e => sysSet("bright", +e.target.value);
$("ccVol").oninput = e => { sysSet("vol", +e.target.value); if (SYS.mute && SYS.vol) sysSet("mute", false); };
$("ccVol").onchange = blip;
$("ccMute").onclick = () => sysSet("mute", !SYS.mute);
cc.querySelectorAll("[data-open]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { toggleCC(false); openSettings(b.dataset.open); });
$("ccPlay").onclick = () => MEDIA.toggle();
$("ccNext").onclick = () => MEDIA.next();
MEDIA.subs.add(() => {
  const t = MEDIA.tracks[MEDIA.idx];
  $("ccTitle").textContent = t.title; $("ccArtist").textContent = t.artist;
  $("ccPlay").innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-' + (MEDIA.playing ? "pause" : "play") + '"></i>';
});

/* Account chip in the menu bar */
function accName() { try { return JSON.parse(ls.get("sift.account") || "null")?.name || "User"; } catch { return "User"; } }
function refreshUser() {
  const n = accName(), c = n.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  $("topUserName").textContent = n; $("topAv").textContent = c;
  $("umName").textContent = n; $("umAv").textContent = c;
}
$("topUser").onclick = e => {

  if (!umenu.hidden) { umenu.hidden = true; return; }
  toggleCC(false); menu.hidden = true; $("helpMenu").hidden = true; refreshUser();
  umenu.hidden = false;

  umenu.style.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(innerWidth - umenu.offsetWidth - 8, r.left)) + "px";
};
umenu.querySelector('[data-u="acct"]').onclick = () => { umenu.hidden = true; openSettings("account"); };
umenu.querySelector('[data-u="sys"]').onclick = () => { umenu.hidden = true; openSettings("preferences"); };
umenu.querySelector('[data-u="lock"]').onclick = () => location.reload();
addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
  if (cc.classList.contains("open") && !cc.contains(e.target) && !$("topCcBtn").contains(e.target)) toggleCC(false);
  if (!umenu.hidden && !umenu.contains(e.target) && !$("topUser").contains(e.target)) umenu.hidden = true;
  if (!($("helpMenu").hidden) && !$("helpMenu").contains(e.target) && !$("topHelpBtn").contains(e.target)) $("helpMenu").hidden = true;
});
addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Escape") { toggleCC(false); umenu.hidden = true; $("helpMenu").hidden = true; } });

/* New Settings tabs */
const swRow = (k, t, d) => `<div class="st-row"><div><b>${t}</b><p>${d}</p></div><button type="button" class="sw${SYS[k] ? " on" : ""}" data-k="${k}" role="switch" aria-checked="${SYS[k]}" aria-label="${t}"></button></div>`;
const rgRow = (k, t, min, max) => `<div class="st-row st-rg"><b>${t}</b><input type="range" class="cc-range" data-k="${k}" min="${min}" max="${max}" value="${SYS[k]}" aria-label="${t}"></div>`;
const stHead = (t, s) => `<h2 class="st-heading">${t}</h2><p class="st-sub">${s}</p>`;
function bindSys(m) {
  m.querySelectorAll(".sw").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
    const k = b.dataset.k; sysSet(k, !SYS[k]);
    b.classList.toggle("on", SYS[k]); b.setAttribute("aria-checked", SYS[k]);
  });
  m.querySelectorAll("input.cc-range").forEach(r => {
    setF(r);
    r.oninput = () => { sysSet(r.dataset.k, +r.value); setF(r); };
    if (r.dataset.k === "vol") r.onchange = blip;
  });
  m.querySelectorAll("select[data-k]").forEach(s => s.onchange = () => sysSet(s.dataset.k, +s.value));
}
const SYS_TABS = {
  display: m => {
    m.innerHTML = stHead("Display", "Brightness and screen colour. Also in Control Center.")
      + `<div class="st-card">${rgRow("bright", "Brightness", 25, 100)}${swRow("night", "Night Shift", "Warms the screen colours.")}</div>`;
    bindSys(m);
  },
  sound: m => {
    m.innerHTML = stHead("Sound", "Volume for system sounds. Games and apps keep their own volume.")
      + `<div class="st-card">${rgRow("vol", "Volume", 0, 100)}${swRow("mute", "Mute", "Silence all system sounds.")}${swRow("sfx", "Sound on volume change", "Play a short tone when you let go of the slider.")}</div>`;
    bindSys(m);
  },
  network: m => {
    m.innerHTML = stHead("Network", "These are simulated. A web page can't control real Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or AirDrop.")
      + `<div class="st-card">${swRow("wifi", "Wi-Fi", "Connect to the SIFT Network.")}${swRow("bt", "Bluetooth", "Make this desktop discoverable.")}</div>`
      + `<div class="st-card"><div class="st-field" style="margin-top:0"><label for="st-air">AirDrop</label><select id="st-air" data-k="air">${AIR_MODES.map((n, i) => `<option value="${i}"${SYS.air === i ? " selected" : ""}>${n}</option>`).join("")}</select></div></div>`;
    bindSys(m);
  },
  notifications: m => {
    m.innerHTML = stHead("Notifications", "Control pop-ups and the desktop updates card.")
      + `<div class="st-card">${swRow("dnd", "Do Not Disturb", "Hide pop-up notifications.")}${swRow("widgets", "Release Notes widget", "Show the updates card on the desktop.")}</div>`;
    bindSys(m);
  },
  datetime: m => {
    m.innerHTML = stHead("Date & Time", "How the clock looks in the menu bar.")
      + `<div class="st-card">${swRow("clock24", "24-hour time", "Show 17:30 instead of 5:30 PM.")}${swRow("secs", "Show seconds", "Add seconds to the menu bar clock.")}</div>`;
    bindSys(m);
  },
  access: m => {
    m.innerHTML = stHead("Accessibility", "Make the desktop easier on the eyes.")
      + `<div class="st-card">${swRow("rmotion", "Reduce motion", "Turn off most animations and transitions.")}${swRow("rtrans", "Reduce transparency", "Replace blurred glass with solid panels.")}</div>`;
    bindSys(m);
  }
};

applySystem();
refreshUser();
MEDIA.emit();

function tick() {
  const d = new Date();
  const wk = d.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: "short" });
  const mo = d.toLocaleDateString([], { month: "short" });
  const dy = d.getDate();
  const tm = d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: SYS.clock24 ? "2-digit" : "numeric", minute: "2-digit", ...(SYS.secs ? { second: "2-digit" } : {}), hour12: !SYS.clock24 });
  $("clock").textContent = `${wk} ${mo} ${dy}  ${tm}`;
  $("dayName").textContent = d.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: "long" }).toUpperCase();
  $("dateTxt").textContent = d.toLocaleDateString([], { month: "long", day: "numeric" });
}
tick(); setInterval(tick, 1000);

/* ===== WALLPAPER & DOCS DIALOGS ===== */
$("wp-apply").onclick = () => {

};
$("wp-up").onclick = () => $("wp-file").click();
$("wp-file").onchange = e => {
  const file = e.target.files[0];
  if (!file) return;

  r.onload = () => { ls.set("sh0zy.bg", r.result); applySettings(); $("wp").close(); notify("Wallpaper uploaded!"); };
  r.readAsDataURL(file);
};
$("wp-p1").onclick = () => { ls.set("sh0zy.bg", PRESET_WALLPAPERS[0].url); applySettings(); $("wp").close(); };
$("wp-p2").onclick = () => { ls.set("sh0zy.bg", PRESET_WALLPAPERS[1].url); applySettings(); $("wp").close(); };

$("wp-x").onclick = () => $("wp").close();

function openDoc(type) {

}
$("doc-x").onclick = () => $("doc").close();
menu.querySelectorAll("[data-doc]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { menu.hidden = true; openDoc(b.dataset.doc); });
document.querySelectorAll("[data-doc]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { $("helpMenu").hidden = true; menu.hidden = true; openDoc(b.dataset.doc); });

/* ===== TOP MENU BAR INTERACTIONS ===== */
function showMenu(x, y) {
  menu.querySelector('[data-a="start"]').onclick = () => { menu.hidden = true; toggleStartMenu(true); };
  menu.querySelector('[data-a="expose"]').onclick = () => { menu.hidden = true; toggleExpose(true); };
  menu.querySelector('[data-a="wall"]').onclick = () => { menu.hidden = true; $("wp").showModal(); };
  menu.querySelector('[data-a="settings"]').onclick = () => { menu.hidden = true; openSettings("preferences"); };
  menu.querySelector('[data-a="ab"]').onclick = () => { menu.hidden = true; launchAboutBlank(); };
  menu.querySelector('[data-a="blob"]').onclick = () => { menu.hidden = true; launchBlob(); };

  menu.style.left = Math.min(innerWidth - menu.offsetWidth - 8, x) + "px";

$("menuBtn").onclick = e => {

};
$("topActiveApp").onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleStartMenu(true); };
$("topFileBtn").onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleStartMenu(true); };
$("topEditBtn").onclick = () => openSettings("cloaking");
$("topViewBtn").onclick = () => openSettings("themes");
$("topWindowBtn").onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleExpose(true); };
$("topHelpBtn").onclick = e => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  menu.hidden = true;
  const hm = $("helpMenu");
  hm.hidden = !hm.hidden;
  const r = $("topHelpBtn").getBoundingClientRect();
  hm.style.top = r.bottom + 6 + "px";
  hm.style.left = Math.max(8, r.left) + "px";
};
$("topWifiBtn").onclick = () => notify(SYS.wifi ? "Connected to SIFT Network" : "Wi-Fi is turned off");
$("topSearchBtn").onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleSpotlight(); };

window.onpointerdown = e => {
  if (!menu.contains(e.target) && !$("menuBtn").contains(e.target)) menu.hidden = true;
};
window.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "k") {
    e.preventDefault();
    toggleSpotlight();
  }
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    if (spotlight.classList.contains("open")) toggleSpotlight(false);
    if (startMenu.classList.contains("open")) toggleStartMenu(false);
    if (expose.classList.contains("open")) toggleExpose(false);
    if ($("firstRunGuide").classList.contains("open")) closeFirstRunGuide();
  }
});

/* ===== SETUP WIZARD & BOOT FLOW ===== */
let setupData = { name: "User", pass: "", hint: "", theme: "glass", acc: "#2b7fff" };

function enterDesktop() {
  refreshUser();
  $("boot").classList.add("done");
  document.body.classList.add("booted");
  if (ls.get("sift.guideDone") !== "1") {
    setTimeout(() => openFirstRunGuide(0), 900);
  }
}

function initSetupWizard() {
  const accountDone = ls.get("sift.setupDone") === "1";
  let savedAccount = null;
  try { savedAccount = JSON.parse(ls.get("sift.account") || "null"); } catch {}

  $("helloBtn").onclick = () => {
    $("bootHelloStage").style.display = "none";
    $("helloBtn").style.display = "none";

    if (accountDone && savedAccount) {
      const userName = savedAccount.name || "User";
      $("boot").classList.add("step-welcome");
      $("setupWelcomeCard").hidden = false;
      $("setupAvatarInitial").textContent = userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
      $("setupWelcomeTitle").textContent = `Welcome, ${userName}`;

      if (savedAccount.pass) {
        $("setupWelcomeSub").textContent = "Enter your password to unlock your desktop.";
        $("lockLoginBox").hidden = false;
        $("lockHintTxt").textContent = "";
        setTimeout(() => $("lockPassInput").focus(), 60);

        const tryUnlock = () => {
          if ($("lockPassInput").value === savedAccount.pass) {
            enterDesktop();
          } else {
            $("lockPassPill").classList.remove("shake");
            void $("lockPassPill").offsetWidth;
            $("lockPassPill").classList.add("shake");
            $("lockPassInput").value = "";
            $("lockHintTxt").textContent = savedAccount.hint
              ? `Incorrect password · Hint: ${savedAccount.hint}`
              : "Incorrect password. Try again.";
          }
        };
        $("lockUnlockBtn").onclick = tryUnlock;
        $("lockPassInput").onkeydown = e => {
          if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); tryUnlock(); }
        };
      } else {
        $("setupWelcomeSub").textContent = "Signing in to your desktop…";
        $("lockLoginBox").hidden = true;
        setTimeout(enterDesktop, 1200);
      }
      return;
    }

    $("boot").classList.add("step-setup");
    $("setupAccountCard").hidden = false;
    setTimeout(() => $("setupName").focus(), 60);
  };

  $("setupPass").addEventListener("input", () => {
    const hasPass = $("setupPass").value.length > 0;
    $("rowVerify").hidden = !hasPass;
    $("rowHint").hidden = !hasPass;
  });

  [$("setupName"), $("setupPass"), $("setupVerify"), $("setupHint")].forEach(inp => {
    inp.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
      if (e.key === "Enter") {
        e.preventDefault();
        $("setupAccountNext").click();
      }
    });
  });

  $("setupAccountNext").onclick = () => {
    const nameVal = $("setupName").value.trim();
    const passVal = $("setupPass").value;
    const verifyVal = $("setupVerify").value;
    const hintVal = $("setupHint").value.trim();
    if (!nameVal) { notify("Please enter your full name."); $("setupName").focus(); return; }
    if (passVal && passVal !== verifyVal) { notify("Passwords do not match."); $("setupVerify").focus(); return; }
    setupData.name = nameVal;
    setupData.pass = passVal;
    setupData.hint = hintVal;

    $("setupAccountCard").hidden = true;
    $("setupLookCard").hidden = false;
  };

  $("setupLookCard").querySelectorAll(".look-choice").forEach(card => {
    card.onclick = () => {
      $("setupLookCard").querySelectorAll(".look-choice").forEach(c => c.classList.remove("selected"));
      card.classList.add("selected");
      setupData.theme = card.dataset.theme;
    };
  });

  $("setupSwatches").querySelectorAll(".accent-dot").forEach(sw => {
    sw.onclick = () => {
      $("setupSwatches").querySelectorAll(".accent-dot").forEach(s => s.classList.remove("selected"));
      sw.classList.add("selected");
      setupData.acc = sw.dataset.acc;
    };
  });

  $("setupLookNext").onclick = () => {
    ls.set("sh0zy.theme", setupData.theme);
    ls.set("sh0zy.acc", setupData.acc);
    applySettings();

    $("setupLookCard").hidden = true;
    $("boot").classList.remove("step-setup");
    $("boot").classList.add("step-welcome");
    $("setupWelcomeCard").hidden = false;
    $("lockLoginBox").hidden = true;
    $("setupAvatarInitial").textContent = setupData.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
    $("setupWelcomeTitle").textContent = `Welcome, ${setupData.name}`;
    $("setupWelcomeSub").textContent = setupData.pass
      ? "Your desktop will ask for your password each time it starts."
      : "Your account is ready.";

    ls.set("sift.account", JSON.stringify(setupData));
    ls.set("sift.setupDone", "1");

    setTimeout(enterDesktop, 1900);
  };
}

/* ===== INIT ===== */
async function init() {
  applySettings();
  try {
    const r = await fetch(BASE + "pages.json");
    if (r.ok) {
      pages = await r.json();
      pages.forEach(p => {
        let k = slugOf(p);
        if (k !== "home" && k !== "index") {
          let file = p.file;
          if (k === "games") file = "ofcgames.html";
          apps.set(k, { key: k, name: p.name, icon: p.icon, file: file });
        }
      });
    }
  } catch {}
  if (apps.size === 0) {
    apps.set("games", { key: "games", name: "Games", icon: "gamepad", file: "ofcgames.html" });
    apps.set("chat", { key: "chat", name: "Chat", icon: "chat", file: "chat.html" });
    apps.set("ai", { key: "ai", name: "AI", icon: "robot", file: "ai.html" });
  } else {
    if (apps.has("games")) apps.get("games").file = "ofcgames.html";
  }

  apps.set("paint", { key: "paint", name: "Paint", icon: "paint", native: "paint" });
  apps.set("calculator", { key: "calculator", name: "Calculator", icon: "calculator", native: "calculator" });
  apps.set("notes", { key: "notes", name: "Notes", icon: "notes", native: "notes" });
  apps.set("weather", { key: "weather", name: "Weather", icon: "weather", native: "weather" });
  apps.set("music", { key: "music", name: "Music", icon: "music", native: "music" });
  apps.set("terminal", { key: "terminal", name: "Terminal", icon: "terminal", native: "terminal" });
  apps.set("clock", { key: "clock", name: "Clock", icon: "clock", native: "clock" });

  buildDock();
  renderStartMenu();
  initSetupWizard();

  if (window.self === window.top && location.protocol !== "blob:") {
    if (ls.get("sh0zy.autoab") === "1") launchAboutBlank();
    else if (ls.get("sh0zy.autoblob") === "1") launchBlob();
  }
}

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>
